We’ve added some additional logging to help us track these down, and we’ve been getting helpful information from that logging in recent PUP builds. If your game is crashing, we ask that you [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]reach out to our Support Team[/url] for solutions and to provide our team with more information about the issue. You may be asked to submit files that give us important information about why you’re experiencing problems, and perhaps even directed to [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-46295#ongoing_pupp]PUPP[/url] to help us confirm if we’ve been able to resolve your issue.

notes.title: Now Available: the Public Update Preview (PUP) program!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Today we're trying something new with an experimental program inspired by feedback from you—the [i]Age II[/i] community! We’re calling this the [b]Public Update Preview[/b] program, or [b]"PUP"[/b] for short. These Update Previews will not only provide a sneak peek to owners of the game, but an opportunity for passionate players to step up, be recognized, and help us squash issues before they ever arise.

[b]Starting today, everyone that owns [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] on Steam will have immediate access to the Public Update Preview.[/b] This is a publicly-available, Steam 'BETA' branch accessible via your [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] properties menu. Opting into it will give you access to game content that is actively in development for the next game update.
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3108017414047366981/]Instructions on how to access the branch can be found here![/url][/b]
[/list]
These builds will sometimes contain new features, content, or bug fixes—it really depends on what we happen to be doing at the time—but it means that you're invited to take a step behind the curtain and preview everything that’s coming to the game in the weeks leading up to a release. 

Whenever we make these builds available, you’ll see a Public Update Preview branch appear in your Steam 'BETA' list with a name similar to this month's branch:
[list]
[*] [b]pup_march – Public Update Preview – March[/b]
[*] [i](Note that you may need to relaunch Steam.)[/i]
[/list]
You don’t need to redeem any keys or use any passwords; the branch will show up whenever a build is available, and we’ll post in our channels to let you know it’s there. 

This is an experiment for us, and you should expect that we’ll change how we’re doing this over time as we learn the best way to engage with you, collect your feedback, and make sure this process is having the best possible impact on your game's updates. We won’t be able to fix everything you may find or change everything you suggest, but our hope is that you’ll see your feedback represented over time and, together, enhance the value of the official updates we introduce to the game. 

This afternoon, we’re launching with build [b]#45513[/b], which primarily contains a number of bug fixes. We plan to  update the build throughout this process and as batches of fixes or changes come in, but for now, you can start discussing the build and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3108017414047032717/]reporting issues[/url] in the brand-new PUP forum:
[list]
[*] [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/]🛠 Public Update Preview - March[/url][/b]
[*] [i](Note that you [u]must[/u] own the game to access the PUP forum.)[/i]
[/list]
Once we’re ready to start prepping for the update to go Live, a few things will happen:
[list]
[*] We’ll pull back the branch so it no longer appears in your Steam Beta list.
[*] The PUP forum will be archived with all the threads about the current build.
[*] A new branch and forum will appear again when we have a new build and branch to share.
[*] A new list of changes will be posted along with areas you can focus on to make the biggest impact.
[/list]
That's it; those are most of the details you need to get started right away, and we'll continue building our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/6/3106892150602892836/]FAQ[/url] over time as you ask your questions about the Public Update Preview program.

Please join us in strengthening the quality of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] by sharing your voice—we’re definitely listening, and looking for every opportunity to make this the game you love to play :)

See you on the battlefield!

—The World's Edge Team

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 45185
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/950c395f5c62c558fd75a0b7ee8c6d8a1247e757.png[/img]

Here we go! We appreciate your patience as we bundle up and test another package of fixes for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Today, our focus is on the prevalent crashes and errors disrupting the community while sneaking a few balance changes in for our new civilizations. As is our modus operandi, here are the highlights:
[list][*] Updated how the game utilizes [b]CPU[/b] and [b]GPU[/b] resources to avoid taxing systems not running [b]Vsync[/b].
[*] Fixed numerous [b]crashes[/b] reported by the community.
[*] Fixed an [b]out-of-sync error[/b] when [b]spectating a match with fog of war disabled[/b].
[*] Fixed an animation hitch when advancing from one Age to the next.
[*] The tech tree now displays the correct health values of units and buildings.
[*] Buildings can no longer be overlapped when you can't see the enemy's structure.
[*] Fixed issues which prevented units and secondary projectiles from dealing their intended damage.
[*] Adjustments to the [b]Burgundian Coustillier[/b] and to [b]Sicilian bonuses and unique technologies[/b].
[*] Numerous localization fixes.
[*] Ongoing investigation into more community reports!
[/list]
As always, your feedback plays a huge part in setting the course for the game, so keep it coming! Visit the forums, join the Discord, and get involved in the community!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Watch for more updates, and be sure to check out the 'Ongoing Issues' section (below) to see what's at the top of our list in the month(s) to come!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ HOTFIX 45185 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated how GPU and CPU resources are consumed when running the game. When [b]Vsync[/b] is disabled, the FPS will be capped at the monitor’s refresh rate rather than drawing upon all available resources.
[*] Placing a horizontal or vertical gate on top of a Villager will no longer crash the game. (Placing an angled gate will [i]continue[/i] to not crash the game.)
[*] Fixed an out-of-sync error when spectating a game with the fog of war disabled.
[*] Fixed an animation hitch when advancing from one Age to the next.
[*] Fixed a crash when constructing a Stable while the chat narrator is enabled and the game language is set to French.
[*] Fixed a crash when starting any game as the [b]Sicilians[/b] or [b]Burgundians[/b] while using the [b]“Shuffle”[/b] music playlist.
[*] Fixed a spectator crash when counting the number of idle villagers.
[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the [b]Sicilian civilization[/b] tooltip to clarify that [b]Serjeants[/b] are only able to build and repair Donjons, and [i]cannot[/i] (as was improperly stated) repair buildings, siege units, and ships.
[*] Added missing map icons in the [b]Quick Play[/b] menu for the five new maps added to the game via [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3022446487047678558]Update 44725[/url].
[*] The tech tree now displays the correct health values of units and buildings.
[*] Corrected the tech tree tooltips of the unique units for several civilizations.
[*] Improved the legibility of tech tree text for the two new civilizations: the Burgundians and Sicilians.
[*] Fixed the truncation of certain text strings throughout the [i]Lords of the West[/i] campaigns.
[*] Fixed the date and timestamp of news events displayed in-game.
[*] The notification when you complete an event challenge now scales more appropriately when it contains longer text strings.
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Villagers will no longer fight back against Feudal Age [b]Scout Cavalry[/b] or Castle Age [b]Eagle Scouts[/b] when not ordered to do so.
[*] Villagers will now automatically move to finish nearby buildings placed in the fog of war when finished with their current project.
[*] Building foundations can once again be placed over unexplored areas as long as it includes some area that has been explored. Note that you'll still be restricted from placing foundations in fully-unexplored areas of the map.
[*] Building foundations can no longer begin construction if overlapping other structures or foundations that aren't within a player's line of sight.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented [b]Turtle Ships[/b] and [b]Mangonels[/b] from dealing their intended damage, and some secondary projectiles from dealing [i]any[/i] damage in certain circumstances. This fix should also ensure that [b]Ballista Elephants[/b] can cut through forests, as intended.
[*] Fixed an issue which would prevent the construction of [b]Gates[/b] due to a failed obstruction check, despite there being no obstructions.
[*] Defeated players can no longer launch surprise attacks with garrisoned units while spectating the remainder of their match.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Burgundians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Coustillier:[/b] Reduced charge damage from [b]+35 ▶ +25[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Coustillier:[/b] Reduced charge damage from [b]+40 ▶ +30[/b].
[*] [b]Coustillier [Standard & Elite]:[/b] No longer deals double damage against units with the ‘Archer’ armor class.
[/list]
[h3][b]Sicilians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 CIVILIZATION[/b]
[list]
[*] On Nomad-style maps, the first [b]Town Center[/b] to be built no longer benefits from the Sicilian construction speed bonus.
[*] The civilization’s resistance to bonus damage is no longer applied to siege weapons.
[*] Serjeants can no longer construct [b]Donjons[/b] in the Battle Royale game mode.
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]First Crusade:[/b] Reduced the number of [b]Serjeants[/b] spawned per Town Center from [b]10 ▶ 7[/b].
[*] [b]Scutage:[/b] Now awards gold to each ally based on the size of their [i]own[/i] military rather than the military count of the researching player.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would prevent the sending of messages after finding a Quick Play match.
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Added localized text for the countdown timer that appears in the [b]Attila 4 (‘A Barbarian Betrothal’)[/b] mission.
[*] Fixed instances where the objective text would not display localized variants during [b]The Grand Dukes of the West 2 (‘The Wolf and the Lion’)[/b] campaign mission.
[*] Updated the legibility of certain diacritics on the [b]e[/b] and [b]i[/b] letters which were difficult to read.
[*] [b]CN:[/b] Updated the names of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] campaigns to display the proper headers on the Western Europe selection screen.
[*] [b]DE:[/b] Updated the names of the Lords of the West campaigns to appear visually consistent with other campaign titles.
[*] [b]FR:[/b] Added missing translations to the [b]Sicilian[/b] history page.
[*] [b]IT:[/b] Fixed a mismatched text and audio line in the outro cinematic of the [b]The Grand Dukes of the West 1 (‘A Kingdom Divided’)[/b] campaign mission.
[/list]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]     ◆ ONGOING INVESTIGATION ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list]
[*] [b]Memory Crashes:[/b] Some players have reported memory crashes that require additional information to address. If you are experiencing regular crashes of any kind, please [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]reach out to our support team[/url] for solutions and to provide our team more information about the issue.
[*] [b]Unable to Reconnect:[/b]  We are working on a solution in addition to improvements to ensure that players can quickly and easily reconnect to their games when they disconnect or drop due to a network or Xbox Live issue. We hear you and recognize the frustration this can cause.
[*] [b]Scenario Editor: direct_placement or grouped_by_team affects player land generation in consecutive maps.[/b] If direct_placement or grouped_by_team is used when generating a map in the editor, additional maps generated in the same editor session will not do so properly. Until this can be fixed (tentatively aiming for the quarterly update), a workaround is to restart the title to ensure maps are generated properly.

For other known issues, please visit [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/articles/360049490811-Known-Issues-Solutions]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!
[quote]Note that this list is subject to change and should not be considered a [i]comprehensive[/i] list of every known issue we’re tracking. The above is provided as insight into the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote]

[hr][/hr][code][h1]          ◆ MOD WARNING ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 44725
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/8e82140a7edf956705312f98ab26120aa909bc50.png[/img]

Welcome to another monumental week for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i] Not only are we kicking it off with a transport ship full of features and fixes, but we're laying the groundwork for the first official expansion—[url=https://www.ageofempires.com/games/aoeiide/lords-of-the-west/][i]Lords of the West[/i][/url]—which introduces two new civilizations, three new campaigns, and expands the tools with which to build your empire!

Update 44725 lays the groundwork for the expansion with improvements to the stability and performance of the game—including fixes for the multiplayer performance setbacks following the November update—along with several new features, a new in-game event, and other challenges to improve your experience. Check out some of the highlights:
[list]
[*] Join the [b]New Year Celebration[/b] and unlock exclusive new icons and mods!
[*] Owners of the [i]Lords of the West[/i] expansion get early access to the two new civilizations in multiplayer: the [b]Burgundians[/b] and [b]Sicilians![/b]
[*] Numerous fixes to multiplayer performance and stability issues
[*] The profanity filter now targets specific ##### words rather than the whole ***** sentence
[*] Building blueprints can no longer be used to "scout" terrain that doesn't have visibility
[*] Five new maps: [b]African Clearing, Amazon Tunnel, Atacama, Coastal Forest, Seize the Mountain[/b]
[*] Unofficial mods are now disabled upon game update to prevent compatibility issues
[*] AI and pathfinding improvements galore!
[*] [i]...and more![/i]
[/list]
We're hoping this helps kick 2021 off to a *great* start, and creates a solid foundation for not only the expansion, but everything we have in store for the year to come (so much good stuff). As always, this includes input from all of you—the community—so come

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We look forward to joining you for the big launch tomorrow, and hope you enjoy everything today's update brings to the game! ♥

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 44725 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b][/h1]
[hr][/hr]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with this month's update:

[h3][b]Join the New Year Celebration![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=A8IgR1O-lhM;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🥳 JANUARY 25 through FEBRUARY 8[/h3][/code]A new year means a new chapter in the history books, as well as another reason to celebrate in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i]

[h3][b]NEW CIV! The Burgundians ([i]Lords of the West[/i])[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/lotw-screen-02-desk.jpg[/img][quote][i]“Rise from a mere duchy to the marvel of Western Europe through economic might, cultural achievement, and the use of advanced military technology and tactics.”[/i][/quote][b]🡒 OVERVIEW[/b]
The Burgundians are a new cavalry civilization specializing in economic development. Take advantage of their ability to perform economic upgrades one Age earlier than other civilizations, cheaper stable technologies, and more powerful gunpowder units to dominate your opponents on the battlefield.

Click below to see the different tools the Burgundians bring to the battlefield!

[b]Civilization Bonuses[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Economic upgrades are available one Age earlier than other civs
[*] Stable technologies are 50% cheaper
[*] Gunpowder units gain a +25% bonus to their attack
[*] Cavalier upgrade is available in the Castle Age
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Team Bonus[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] Relics generate both Gold and Food
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Units[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]

[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Unique Technologies[/b]
[expand type=details]
[list]
[*] [b]Burgundian Vineyards:[/b] Convert all food into gold at a 2:1 ratio; Farmers slowly generate gold in addition to food.
[*] [b]Flemish Revolution:[/b] Upgrades all existing Villagers into [b]Flemish Militia[/b], and allows the training of Flemish Militia at Town Centers.
[/list]
[/expand]
[b]Full Technology Tree[/b]
[expand type=details]
[url=https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2021/01/lotw_burgundiantechtree.png[/img][/url]
[/expand]

[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3]
[list]

[*] Implemented fixes to performance dips that could occur when a player Ages-Up.
[*] Fixed a crash when exiting the profile screen while it is loading.
[*] Fixed a crash in the [b]Battle Royale[/b] mode triggered when the corruption damaged a non-combatant object.
[*] Fixed a rare issue which would cause the game to stall after submitting a player report.

[h3][b]Achievements[/b][/h3]
[list]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a building’s [b]research complete[/b] animation could fail to spawn the particles if multiple research projects were queued in the same building.
[/list]

[list][*] The [b]Stormy Dog[/b] cheat unit now [i]♪ barks ♪[/i] when selected.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Bonus stats granted to unit(s) via automatic upgrades are now displayed in the base unit stats. As an example, an inherit bonus to attack granted to Scout Cavalry in the Feudal Age would be displayed as [b]5[/b] instead of [b]3+2[/b].

[*] The [b]Report Player[/b] modal no longer remains disabled after submitting a report.

If you encounter performance or stability issues after your mods are disabled, please visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url] for assistance!

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 43210
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/d7da8ae021bfe4192938a3e38d4611b260fc5ddf.png[/img]

[i]New update coming in 4…3…2…1…0![/i]

Today’s hotfix introduces several critical fixes to issues that cropped up after the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2899717056068498112]November Anniversary Update[/url]. Most notably, it brings numerous stability improvements and crash fixes to the game, additional menu narration (when enabled) for the new UI areas of the game, the implementation of missing translations for several languages, and changes which address some clever exploits and issues uncovered in the Battle Royale game mode.

As always, these are based on feedback from the community, so don’t stop now; visit the forum and let us know what you’d like to see next!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We’ll be watching for feedback even as the World’s Edge team breaks for the American holiday! We hope you enjoy the hotfix and everything the November Update was meant to offer! 🖤

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr]
[h1]UPDATE 43210
[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]◆ [b]GAME[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3][list][*] Implemented fixes for the situation where a player experiencing a performance spike in later stages of the game would cause degradation in animation smoothness for the remainder of the match. Note that this does not fix all lag issues everywhere: as individual PC performance, match settings (i.e. high pop, high participant games), and the random turmoil of internet gremlins can still have an adverse affect on the playability of the game.
[*] The game will no longer crash if the ranked queue pops while viewing the tech tree.
[*] Likewise, the game will no longer black-screen if a match drops or fails to connect while viewing the tech tree.
[*] The game UI no longer freezes when the “Failed to Join Match” modal pops while the [b]Select Civilization[/b] menu is open.
[*] The game UI no longer freezes when the the [b]UGC warning[/b] appears while the [b]Select Civilization[/b] menu is open.
[*] Fixed an issue which could cause the game to hard-lock when a player disconnected on the victory or defeat screen.
[*] Fixed an uncommon crash when queuing to join a Battle Royale Quick Play game.
[*] Implemented several additional fixes for uncommon crashes.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Added the new [b]Battle Royale[/b] option to the [b]Game Mode[/b] filter in the Lobby Browser.
[*] Halved the animation time of the new UI windows and confirmation prompts within the game.
[*] Unique Unit icons have been added to each civ on the [b]Select Civilization[/b] screen playing in non-English languages.
[*] Fixed an issue where using the arrow keys or tab to cycle through the [b]Select Civilization[/b] menu would fail to update the details of the currently-selected civilization.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]“Lobby Full”[/b] popup would constantly reappear after inviting a user to a lobby that subsequently fills.
[*] Fixed an issue which could prevent a player’s selected civilization from showing up on the match loading screen.[/list]
[h3][b]Settings[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Added menu narration to the tooltip text for each civilization on the [b]Select Civilization[/b] screen.
[*] Added menu narration to the new [b]Quick Play[/b] screen elements.
[*] Added menu narration to the [b]Respond[/b] buttons in the [b]Pending Invitations[/b] modal.
[*] Added menu narration to the [b]Accept[/b] and [b]Decline[/b] buttons in the [b]Clan Requests[/b] menu.
[*] Added menu narration to the [b]Close (X)[/b] button on the Yes/No dialogue that appears when exiting the queue.
[*] The narrator now reads the title and tooltips of the [b]Settings Cog, Invites[/b], and [b]Profile[/b] UI elements on the home screen.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] [b]Monks[/b] can no longer be used to cheat death in the Battle Royale game mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where the object named “Invisible object that keeps player alive” would, contrary to its purpose, slowly inflict death upon nearby player units and buildings. This affected a number of custom maps and scenarios.
[*] Fixed a bug where attempting to remove a technology from the [b]global queue[/b] would result in units being removed instead.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGN[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][list][*] On timed missions, the bronze medal timer is now properly displayed when the silver medal timer expires.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Arambai:[/b] The increased reload time added in the November Update now only applies to [b]non-elite Arambai[/b], as intended. So, the reload time of [b]Elite Arambai[/b] is [b]2.0[/b] and [b]2.2[/b] for non-elite [b]Arambai[/b].[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue which could prevent game invitations from displaying properly for the receiving user.
[*] Restored games will now populate the invite list with the players that were in the original game rather than the full list of players who cannot join the game.
[*] Advanced game settings will no longer be displayed and configurable in Restored Game lobbies.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOCALIZATION[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Added the missing translation text for an objective in [b]The Falcon’s Nest (Pachacuti 4)[/b] scenario.
[*] [b]Spanish (ES-ES, ES-MX):[/b] Corrected several percentage numbers which displayed the incorrect values when using the [b]Spanish[/b] or [b]Latin American Spanish[/b] languages.
[*] [b]French (FR-FR):[/b] Updated the description of the [b]Saracen archer bonus[/b] to clarify that it affects only archers, not cavalry archers.
[*] [b]German (DE-DE):[/b] Updated the Magyar civ description to clarify that a Blacksmith is not needed to benefit from the free [b]Forging, Iron Casting[/b], and [b]Blast Furnace[/b] technologies.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] [b]SHIFT+Clicking[/b] the [b]Priority Up[/b] and [b]Priority Down[/b] buttons will now, once again, allow you to quickly prioritize the selected mods as the highest and lowest priority, respectively.[/list]


[hr][/hr]
[h1]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list][*] [b]Scenario Editor Crash:[/b] There is an issue being tracked which can result in the Scenario Editor crash when generating a map multiple times. A fix is being worked on and will be implemented in a future, major update when it has been tested and approved.
[*] All previous notes from the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2899717056068498112]November Update[/url] continue to be relevant as we prepare the next official build. Keep an eye on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]forums[/url], official social channels, and the [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support site[/url] for the latest details![/list]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote][quote]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you are experiencing issues launching or playing the game after downloading the new build, try [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/mods]disabling your installed mods[/url] before trying again.

Still having trouble? Visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url]![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 42848
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fd466ff74a8ffdb8a1f132bf21fa27839ff42e57.png[/img]

HAPPY NOVEMBER, and HAPPY ONE-YEAR ANNIVERSARY to [i]AGE OF EMPIRES II: DEFINITIVE EDITION[/i]!

For those of you who’ve been with us since November of last year, we’re thrilled to share in this journey with you: exploring new frontiers for the game with never-before-seen content, new systems and features, and sharing the battlefield with you month after month! This past year has been [i]full[/i] of projects and improvements to the game; for perspective, here’s just a few of the biggest highlights from the last twelve months:
[list][*] 20 Game Updates (now 21)!
[*] 10 in-game events, including two crossovers with other franchise games!
[*] 4 new Art of War missions!
[*] Two new Challenge Scenarios: the Mongol Raiders (which will return) and Barbarossa Brawl!
[*] Three new Maps based off community favorites: Four Lakes, Golden Swamp, and Land Nomad!
[*] New Unlocks, Campaign Medals, and Rewards!
[*] Updated matchmaking to offer unique map pools for 1v1/Team Games and Random Match/Deathmatch!
[*] Ranked map bans and preferred map selection!
[*] AI Improvements GALORE!
[*] New Stats-tracking and Leaderboards!
[*] [i]…and much, much more![/i][/list]
All of this has been completely [i]FREE[/i] for owners of the game, and only begins to lay the groundwork for all that’s yet to come! This month, we’re continuing the game’s growth with another massive update: including an all-new game mode to test your skills, a plethora of fixes and improvements, balance changes to 19 of the 35 civilizations and to 15 different maps, modding enhancements to offer even greater power at your fingertips, and so much more! As always, here’s the tl;dr list:
[list][*] New game mode: [b]Battle Royale![/b]
[*] New seasonal event: [b]The Age of Empires II: DE Anniversary Event![/b]
[*] New [b]Quick Play[/b] functionality: featuring [b]Random Map, Battle Royale[/b], and [b]Empire Wars![/b]
[*] Various [b]performance and stability improvements![/b]
[*] Improved [b]wall placement[/b] and other quality of life features!
[*] A plethora of [b]civilization, map, and gameplay balance changes![/b]
[*] The [b]‘Prefer Random’[/b] multiplayer option now takes effect if selected by a majority of players!
[*] New and improved functionality for the [b]Scenario Editor[/b]: including new triggers and .xs scripting support![/list]
As always, these changes are based on your feedback over the past months (and, now, year)! We want to offer our sincerest thanks to everyone who continues to entrust us with this franchise and continues to offer ideas as to how we can make it better. To all of you who participated in a thoughtful, meaningful, inclusive, and understanding way over the past year: THANK YOU from all of us at World’s Edge and from the [i]Age of Empires[/i] teams! Keep it up and we’ll continue building a game worthy of the RTS crown for the year (and years) to come!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
That’s enough from me! We hope you enjoy Update 42848 and all that it brings to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Thanks for helping us get through this past year; we can’t wait to share what we have in store for the next! 😉

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[hr][/hr]
[h1]UPDATE 42848[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with this month's update:

[h3][b]Happy Birthday Age of Empires II: DE![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=LlvT6AKzQD8;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🍰 NOVEMBER 17 through DECEMBER 1[/h3][/code]November marks the first anniversary of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], and we’re celebrating its birthday with one of the biggest updates yet! Along with a long list of brand-new features and fixes to expand the tools in your arsenal, we’re throwing a party to celebrate the first of MANY years to come for [i]Age of Empires II: DE[/i]! Check out the requirements below, jump into the game, and unlock a slew of birthday presents!
[list][*]  Unlock four new [b]PROFILE ICONS![/b] Grab a bit of birthday cake, pin the arrow on the Huskarl, or celebrate Cuman style!
[*] Decorate your Town Center with [b]BIRTHDAY PARTY DECORATIONS![/b]
[*] Strap some [b]BIRTHDAY FIREWORKS[/b] to your exploding Petards, Flaming Camels, and Demolition Ships!
[*] Celebrate science and the new Age with [b]CONFETTI[/b] when your research or Age-up completes![/list]
[table][tr]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_anniversary_boom.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_anniversary_cake.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_anniversary_huskarl.png[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_aniversary_cuman.png[/img][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[b]▶︎ NEW REWARDS![/b]
[b]Starting TODAY through DECEMBER 1,[/b] complete daily in-game tasks to unlock event-themed goodies:
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Exploding Demo Ship[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b][/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Complete a Battle Royale game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Town Center Birthday Party Decorations[/b] mod.
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Birthday Cake[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Using Quick Play, play an Empire Wars game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Pin the Arrow on the Huskarl[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Survive 15 minutes in a Battle Royale match.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]“1”-shaped Fireworks[/b] mod to “celebrate” with your Petards, Flaming Camels, and Demo Ships.

🔒 [b]Using Quick Play, play a Battle Royale game and place in the Top 4.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Birthday Cuman[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Using Quick Play, play any game and advance to the Imperial Age.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Confetti Explosion[/b] mod when completing research on a tech or upgrading your buildings.
[/code]
[b]▶︎ KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve achieved! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the celebration!

We hope you enjoy the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] Birthday Celebration!  Again, don’t forget to sign into Xbox Live to ensure you keep everything you unlock!

[h3][b]NEW! Multiplayer Quick Play[/b][/h3]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Quick-Play-Nov-2020-2048x888.jpg[/img]

It’s also now easier than ever to jump in and play [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] with [b]Quick Play![/b] This feature allows players to set a game type and map preferences, then effortlessly matchmake with others in the Random Map, Empire Wars, and Battle Royale game modes.

To access [b]Quick Play[/b], click the [b]‘Multiplayer’[/b] button on the game home screen.

[h3][b]NEW! Battle Royale (Quick Play)[/b][/h3]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Battle-Royale-Menu-Nov-2020-2048x888.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Royale[/b] introduces a brand-new way to experience [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]! This fast-paced mode pits up to 8 players (or AI players in a skirmish) against each other on 5 new maps in a free-for-all contest to see who can be the last combatant standing.

[i]Who will win? Make sure it’s you![/i]

To access Battle Royale, you can either select it in the [b]Quick Play[/b] menu, or you can click the [b]‘Battle Royale’[/b] button on the home screen to jump straight to the setup screen.

[h3][b]Multiplayer Updates[/b][/h3]
Both experienced and new players will find the game more welcoming than ever with updates in the overall game UI including improved civilization selection, main menu navigation, and updated party invites.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Multiplayer-Nov-2020.jpg[/img]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Civ-Selection-Nov-2020.gif[/img]

More information can be found in the [b]‘Lobbies & Matchmaking’[/b] section, below!

[h1]◆ [b]GAME[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]Stability & Performance[/b][/h3][list][*] Players are now properly reconnected to their match if they experience a brief drop in their internet connection. This addresses an issue where they would attempt to reconnect indefinitely.
[*] Implemented various performance improvements to how the game is rendered.
[*] Improved the performance of the client during large-scale, late-game battles.
[*] Improved the performance of the client during battles which generate a considerable number of on-screen particles.
[*] Fixed various issues which prevented players from connecting to a match during ranked matchmaking.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented computers running both an integrated graphics chip and a dedicated graphics processing unit from defaulting to their dedicated GPU.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Created a new hotkey entry to quickly [b]“Go to King”[/b] when playing the Regicide game mode.
[*] Created a new hotkey entry that allows you to [b]“Select all Trade Units.”[/b]
[*] The [b]“Select all visible Military Units”[/b] hotkey can now be used to select visible warships if no land units are also visible or by pressing the hotkey twice.
[*] The mouse wheel can now be used to scroll through the tech tree.
[*] Rally points for enemy buildings are no longer displayed on the minimap.[/list]
The percentage numbers have been updated to represent their actual effect for the following bonuses and technologies:
[list][*] [b]Aztecs:[/b] Military bonus
[*] [b]Bulgarians:[/b] Stirrups
[*] [b]Byzantines:[/b] Fire Ship bonus
[*] [b]Celts:[/b] Siege bonus
[*] [b]Celts:[/b] Stronghold
[*] [b]Cumans:[/b] Steppe Husbandry
[*] [b]Ethiopians:[/b] Archer bonus
[*] [b]Incas:[/b] Team bonus
[*] [b]Japanese:[/b] Infantry bonus
[*] [b]Mongols:[/b] Cavalry Archer bonus
[*] [b]Saracens:[/b] Galley bonus
[*] [b]Spanish:[/b] Gunpowder bonus
[*] [b]Turks:[/b] Team bonus[/list]
[h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*] Running [b]Boars, Elephants, and Rhinos[/b] now use the correct [i]♪ “footstep” ♪[/i] sounds, which are 3D-positioned to emit from their position on the screen.
[*] Running [b]Boars, Elephants, and Rhinos[/b] now play their [i]♪ “bestial vocals” ♪[/i] less frequently when pursuing hunters.
[*] Balanced the volume of unit voices across all civilizations, particularly for the Vietnamese, Khmer, Malay, Malians, Portuguese, Bulgarians, and Slavs.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1]
Added a new setting which changes the behavior when double-clicking to select Villagers:
[list][*] Double-click to select all Villagers
[*] Double-click to select only Idle Villagers
[*] Disable double-click to select Villagers[/list]
Other changes to gameplay in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]:
[list][*] Improved the placement of walls, which will now automatically employ angles to cover the shortest distance instead of defaulting to an L-shape.
[*] Fixed an issue where holding SHIFT while placing a wall could prevent some wall piece foundations from being added into the command queue.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where units tasked to attack a wall then re-tasked or set to patrol would, on occasion, continue attacking the wall instead.
[*] Units can now be de-queued from the Global Queue. Holding CTRL and clicking removes 1 unit; holding CTRL + SHIFT and clicking removes 5 units.
[*] [b]Trebuchets[/b] now display their packing progress below their health bar.
[*] [b]Monks[/b] and [b]Missionaries[/b] now display their Faith below their health bar.
[*] [b]Monks[/b] and [b]Monks carrying Relics[/b] are no longer considered the same unit when double-clicking to select.
[*] Defensive buildings no longer prioritize enemy buildings over units.
[*] [b]Town Center[/b] and [b]Gate[/b] foundations are no longer removed from their assigned control groups once the buildings are fully-constructed.
[*] Dismounted [b]Konniks[/b] now properly benefit from unit upgrades.
[*] [b]Attack Move[/b] and [b]Patrol[/b] commands can now be issued when [b]Trebuchets[/b] are included in the selected group. Trebuchets will neither patrol nor attack move, but will move along with the group.
[*] Attack order commands can now be issued to unpacked [b]Trebuchets[/b] by SHIFT + clicking different targets.
[*] Auto-scout is now disabled on units when the owning player resigns.
[*] Units will no longer try to complete their command queue when the owning player resigns.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Lithuanian Relic bonus would not be properly calculated and applied when Relics were stored in multiple Monasteries.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where double-clicking a building could select [i]all[/i] buildings of the type instead of only the visible buildings.
[*] Fixed a rare, legacy issue where a Stop command issued to units could leak onto buildings, causing them to cancel their build queues.
[*] Fixed a rare, legacy issue where [b]Fishing Ships[/b] could collect food from land Farms after exhausting a nearby Fish Trap.
[*] Fixed a rare, legacy issue which could prevent purchases from the [b]Market[/b] despite having the resources to do so.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGN[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Naval Battles:[/b] The “silver medal” notification no longer plays twice when the player loses too many ships.[/list]
[h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Bari 3:[/b] The [b]Bombard Tower[/b] technology can no longer be researched.
[*] [b]Tariq 5:[/b] The [b]Elite Genitour[/b] upgrade is now available at the Archery Range.
[*] [b]Yodit 1:[/b] The highest-earned campaign medal is now correctly displayed after completing the mission.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Wall:[/b] Reduced the melee armor of wall foundations to [b]0[/b].
[*] [b]Palisade Wall:[/b] Increased build time by [b]1 second[/b].
[*] Increased the collision size multiplier for [b]Elephant units[/b] to match that of other cavalry and ranged units.
[*] [b]Battle Elephant [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced bonus damage to buildings from [b]+7/+10 ▶ +4/+7[/b] respectively.
[*] [b]Xolotl Warrior:[/b] Are now granted +30 hp, +2 attack, and +2/2 armor in matches that begin in the Post-Imperial Age.[/list]
[h3][b]Aztecs[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Reduced the number of bonus resources [b]Villagers[/b] can carry from [b]+5 ▶ +3[/b].
[*] The Aztecs no longer start with extra gold in the Empire Wars mode.[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Jaguar Warrior [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Training time reduced from [b]20 ▶ 12 seconds[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Bulgarians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Increased the rate at which [b]Blacksmiths[/b] work from [b]50% ▶ 80% faster[/b].
[*] [b]Blacksmith[/b] and [b]Siege Workshop[/b] upgrades now cost [b]-50% food[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Arambai [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reload time increased from [b]2.0 ▶ 2.2[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Celts[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] The movement speed bonus for [b]infantry units[/b] is now applied at the start of the Feudal Age.[/list]
[h3][b]Cumans[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Kipchak [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Now have a [b]0.5 second[/b] fire delay, equivalent to the Mangudai.[/list]
[h3][b]Ethiopians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Shotel Warrior [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the cost to train from [b]35 ▶ 30 gold[/b]. Food cost remains the same (50 food).[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Torsion Engines:[/b] Reduced the width of Scorpion projectiles from [b]0.5 ▶ 0.4 tiles[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Goths[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Loom can now be researched [b]instantly[/b] rather than at no cost.[/list]
[h3][b]Indians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] All [b]Stable units[/b] now gain [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Castle Age and [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Imperial Age, as opposed to the +1 pierce armor previously granted only to Camel units.
[*] Reduced the team bonus to damage dealt by [b]Camel units[/b] to buildings from [b]+5 ▶ +4[/b].
[*] No longer have access to the [b]Plate Barding Armor[/b] technology.[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Sultans:[/b] Fixed an issue where captured Relics would generate gold ~17% faster rather than the intended 10%.[/list]
[h3][b]Italians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Genoese Crossbowman:[/b] Training Time reduced from [b]22 ▶ 18 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Genoese Crossbowman:[/b] Training Time reduced from [b]19 ▶ 14 seconds[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Khmer[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Further reduced the work rate of [b]Khmer Farmers[/b] from [b]-3% ▶ -5%[/b].
[*] Reduced the bonus speed to [b]Battle Elephants[/b] from [b]+15% ▶ +10% faster[/b].[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Tusk Swords:[/b] Increased the cost from [b]200 wood, 300 gold ▶ 300 wood, 450 gold[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Koreans[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Now receive archer armor upgrades for free.
[*] Korean [b]Towers[/b] no longer gain the range bonus previously granted during the Castle and Imperial Age.[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Elite Turtle Ship:[/b] Speed increased from [b]0.9 ▶ 1.035[/b].[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Panokseon:[/b] Replaced by the [b]Eupseong[/b] technology.
[*] [b]Eupseong:[/b] This unique technology grants [b]Watch Towers, Guard Towers[/b], and [b]Keeps +2 range[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Lithuanians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Leitis [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced pierce armor from [b]2 ▶ 1[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Malians[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Gbeto [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Fire delay reduced from [b]1.2 ▶ 1.0[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Mayans[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Obsidian Arrows:[/b] No longer grants double the attack bonus versus Stone Walls, Stone Gates, Towers, and Harbors.[/list]
[h3][b]Portuguese[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] All technologies are now researched [b]30% faster[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Spanish[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue which prevented the faster reload time bonus for gunpowder units from benefitting [b]Cannon Galleons[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Tatars[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] [b]Town Centers[/b] will now spawn 2 Sheep upon reaching the Feudal Age, and newly-constructed Town Centers thereafter will also spawn 2 Sheep upon completion.[/list]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Silk Armor:[/b] Increased armor bonuses from [b]+0/+1 ▶ +1/+1 armor[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Turks[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ CIVILIZATION[/b][list][*] [b]Scout Cavalry, Light Cavalry[/b], and [b]Hussar[/b] units gain [b]+1 pierce armor[/b].[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Elite Janissary:[/b] Increased accuracy from [b]50% ▶ 65%[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Vikings[/b][/h3]
[b]▶︎ TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Chieftains:[/b] Increased cost from [b]400 food, 300 gold ▶ 700 food, 500 gold[/b].[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Added safeguards to ensure that [b]Sheep[/b] always spawn in the correct numbers.[/list]
Several changes have been made to the [b]Empire Wars[/b] game mode:
[list][*] Players now begin with [b]5[/b] Farmers (instead of [b]8[/b]). The [b]3[/b] former Farmers are now assigned to berries, wood, and gold at the start of the match.
[*] Herdable animals no longer appear on Empire Wars maps which start with the standard number of villagers.[/list]
[h3][b]Map Balance[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]Antarctica:[/b] The [b]Penguin[/b] has been added as a scouting unit.
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Implemented fixes to prevent small patches of road and snow terrain from appearing throughout the map.
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Cliffs will now avoid generating near forests and player starting areas.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Fixed a bug where gold or stone nodes could occasionally spawn and obstruct gates.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Reduced the length of cliffs throughout the map.
[*] [b]Golden Swamp:[/b] On Empire Wars, a Mill and Villagers are now generated on berry bushes.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Improved the generation of the forested area in the center of the map.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Uprooted random tree spawns from aquatic areas of the map.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Outside gold and stone are no longer clumped together, and spawn further away from forests and water.
[*] [b]Hamburger:[/b] Starting gold and stone spawns are now consistent on free-for-all map generations.
[*] [b]Inner Circle:[/b] On Empires Wars, players now always begin with 3 Lumber Camps.
[*] [b]Journey South:[/b] Added a Scout for players.
[*] [b]Journey South:[/b] On Empire Wars, players now begin with 3 Lumber Camps instead of one.
[*] [b]Mangrove Jungle:[/b] On Empire Wars, players begin with 3 standard Lumber Camps, as well as a Mill and 6 Villagers near a herd of deer.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] Fixed an issue where a particular map type could generate uneven starting forests.
[*] [b]MegaRandom:[/b] On Empire Wars, a Mill and Villagers are now generated on four-tile berry bushes.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Slightly reduced the elevation on the map.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Reduced the total number of spawned goats, which also appear further away from the shorelines.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Removed predators from the map.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] Reduced elevated areas throughout the map.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] Gold, stone, and berries no longer generate next to each other.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] The island now avoids the map edges in all directions.
[*] [b]Pacific Islands:[/b] On Empire Wars, players now begin with 6 additional Fishing Ships.
[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] No longer defaults to the Empire Wars map generation.
[*] [b]Snake Pit:[/b] On Empire Wars, players now start with a Mill and 6 Villagers near a herd of deer.
[*] [b]Wolf Hill:[/b] On Empire Wars, a Mill and Villagers are now generated on berry bushes.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3]
Added a new command, [b]behavior_version[/b], which lets you opt-in to fixes and changes for RMS that are not compatible with older scripts.
[list][*] Using [b]behavior_version 1[/b] will fix the legacy issue where the land_percent and number_of_tiles commands would produce inconsistent results based on the order of lands in the RMS file.[/list]
In addition to this change:
[list][*] Fixed a legacy issue where map revealers would be placed on custom Nomad maps.
[*] The ‘Starting Age’ setting can now be detected by RM scripts.
[*] [b]direct_placement[/b] now works as intended when the number of players greatly exceeds the recommended map size.
[*] Added the [b]set_gaia_unconvertible[/b] command for object generation. Gaia objects created with this flag will not be capturable by players and will instead be hostile to them.
[*] Added the [b]set_gaia_civilization[/b] parameter. Setting it to a valid civilization ID will change Gaia’s civilization in a Random Map game. The civilization’s architectural style and unique techs will be applied to the Gaia player.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1]
A new [b]Quick Play[/b] lobby is now available for unranked play! Quick Play is designed to get you into a match lighting fast: offering the ability to quickly setup your game type and map preferences and then effortlessly join matchmaking with others in the Random Map, Empire Wars, and Battle Royale queues. Quick Play will be unranked and designed for convenience—getting you in a game with only a few clicks.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Quick-Play-Nov-2020-2048x888.jpg[/img]

We’ve also updated the [b]invitation system[/b] to make it easier for you to invite players to your match or clan.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/Invite-UI-Nov-2020.jpg[/img]

Along with these additions, we’ve implemented several changes to the multiplayer lobbies:
[list][*] The [b]Regicide, Empire Wars[/b], and [b]Sudden Death[/b] settings are now available as checkboxes in lobbies, allowing their mechanics to be combined with other game modes.
[*] The Treaty setting is now always on in the [b]Wonder Race[/b] game mode.
[*] [b]Wonder[/b] and [b]Relic[/b] victories are now allowed in the [b]Regicide[/b] game mode and with the [b]Last Man Standing[/b] victory condition.
[*] The [b]Conquest[/b] victory condition is now available in the [b]Regicide[/b] game mode.
[*] The [b]“Prefer Random Civilization”[/b] feature now requires a majority of players in a match to opt-in rather than [i]all[/i] players in the match.
[*] When restoring a game, players can now choose a server, set spectator settings, and set a spectator delay.
[*] Added a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) to instantly spectate matches by clicking a special link.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could be locked out of a match when accepting an invitation to a lobby they’re already in.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]“Create Lobby”[/b] button would, for seemingly no reason, be disabled.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Implemented several improvements to the strategic decision-making of AI-controlled players.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI would fail to target a player to attack.
[*] Fixed an issue which sometimes prevented the AI from placing gates in walls.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI-controlled units could be seen sliding across the screen rather than walking.
[*] Units which benefit from direct unit control will now converge properly.[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Units tasked to follow another unit will now properly update their path when issued a new command.
[*] Units will now update their path when re-tasked to determine whether there is a more optimal route to the task at hand. (Legacy)
[*] Fixed a rare issue where Boars could randomly stop chasing a unit after colliding with an obstruction.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where units at the edge of the map could not be targeted and attacked by melee units.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where units would, on spookier occasions, pass through solid objects.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Added a new strategic number to control what kind of gate the AI places in a wall: set [b]sn-gate-type-for-wall[/b] to [b]1[/b] for a Palisade Gate, and [b]0[/b] for placing Stone or Fortified Gates.
[*] Flares can now be found using the [b]players-unit-type-count[/b] check and [b]up-find-flare[/b].
[*] [b]up-find-flare[/b] will now find flare objects.
[*] [b]object-data-action[/b] and [b]object-data-order[/b] no longer return -1 for objects with no unit AI.
[*] Setting the [b]sn-disable-villager-garrison[/b] properly to 3 now stops boar-lurers from garrisoning.
[*] [b]sn-minimum-number-hunters[/b] will now properly assign Villagers to huntable objects.
[*] [b]sn-object-repair-level[/b] now takes Scorpion and Trebuchet units into consideration.
[*] Created [b]defconsts[/b] for the new [i]Last Khans[/i] civilizations.
[*] Extended the maximum amount of strategic numbers supported from [b]303 ▶ 511[/b].
[*] [b]up-can-build[/b] no longer returns false when using Wall objects.
[*] [b]up-garrison[/b] now accepts unit lines.
[*] [b]up-garrison[/b] now works on distant targets.
[*] [b]up-gather-inside[/b] now works on Watch Towers.
[*] [b]up-path-distance[/b] and [b]up-get-path-distance[/b] no longer returns impassable if the starting tiles’ corner is obstructed by itself or another object.
[*] Using the [b]find-random[/b] search on [b]up-find-player[/b] now returns the correct player ID’s.
[*] Fixed an issue when using a custom AI script which caused AI players to delete the wrong objects under certain circumstances.[/list]
Added [b]map-type[/b] constant for the following maps:
[list][*] Bog Islands
[*] Mangrove Jungle
[*] Pacific Islands
[*] Sandbank
[*] Water Nomad[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOCALIZATION[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Implemented various fixes and updates to non-English translations of the game.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Extended the modding functionality to allow mixed content mods which combine .dat mods with other assets, which will take effect in games where the dataset is selected.
[*] Fixed an issue where the names of the files required to modify [b]civilization theme music[/b] would vary based on the chosen interface language.
[*] Fixed an issue where custom unit sounds included in data mods would not play unless both the “Custom” and “Wwise” fields were non-zero.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/3290d43a326872a32f223641f841d3fe45d7fff1.jpg[/img]

[hr][/hr]
[h1]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/h1]

[hr][/hr]
As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:
[list][*] [b]Team Game Connection Issues:[/b] We're continuing to monitor connectivity problems during Team Games and your continued help is valuable! If you’re experiencing [b](a)[/b] a disconnect during TG gameplay, [b](b)[/b] a disconnect during matchmaking or on the loading screen, or [b](c)[/b] crashing on the matchmaking screen, please read the section above regarding the [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-40874#BUILD-SPOTLIGHT_elb]Enhanced Logging Build[/url] and follow the instructions. This will generate advanced logs that you can share to help us better understand why you’re experiencing these problems.
[*] [b][Spanish] Incorrect percentage numbers in certain unit descriptions:[/b] The team is aware of several incorrect percentage stats when using the Spanish translation of the game. This includes the speed boost increase for the Squires technology, the elephant speed bonus of the Khmer civilization, the hp bonus of the Mongol civ, and the Steppe Husbandry description. These percentages will be corrected and updated in a future release![/list]
[quote][h3]:alertalert: [b]DISCLAIMER[/b][/h3]This list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].
[/quote][quote]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you are experiencing issues launching or playing the game after downloading the new build, try [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/mods]disabling your installed mods[/url] before trying again.

Still having trouble? Visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url]![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 41855
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/69d097680f1a15496ed9409301b964cdccbdc49f.png[/img]

Happy October, [i]Age[/i] fans!

As we move into the final stretch of the year, we’re continuing our monthly release schedule with another small changelist for the game. Today’s build focuses on some key Villager improvements identified by the community, AI improvements for hardcore players, and some audio fixes that benefit the modding community. As has also become the standard, it also comes with a new event: this time celebrating the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/933110/announcements/detail/2927861384152497851]recent launch of [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i][/url] with some exclusive crossover content for you to enjoy.

As many of you have guessed, next month is when we’re targeting the drop of our massive anniversary update! There’s still time to identify fixes and tweaks you’d like to see, so be sure to visit our discussion channels to leave your thoughts:

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We hope you enjoy this month’s release, look forward to hearing from you, and can’t wait to see you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1]▬▬▬ UPDATE 41855 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]Here are some of the biggest highlights coming with this month's update:

[h3][b]Age of Empires III: DE Launch Celebration![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=X8hmB-bVaEY;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🤍 OCTOBER 20 through NOVEMBER 3[/h3][/code]Exactly 14 years and 362 days since its arrival, [i]Age of Empires III[/i] now has a [i]Definitive Edition[/i] to usher in a new beginning for the youngest game in the franchise! We’re ecstatic to celebrate the launch of the new and improved game—so excited, in fact, that we only made you wait 5 days to join the fun! That’s because today marks the beginning of the [b]October celebration[/b], which is themed around the newest member of the family: [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition![/i] So grab your favorite capybara and join in for two weeks of fun, games, and (of course) exclusive unlocks!
[list][*] Unlock three new [b]Profile Icons[/b], including legendary capy-boi, [b]Barry![/b]
[*] Unlock two new mods, including a [b]Great Bombard Cannon statue[/b] for your Town Center and [b]Capybara Projectiles[/b] for your siege machines.
[*] [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i] owners can also unlock a third mod that changes your [b]Hand Cannoneers[/b] to [b]Musketeers![/b]
[*] Unlock a new [b]audio mod[/b] to add that special, [i]Age III[/i] gunpowder sound to your shooty-bois!
[/list]
[table][tr]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_musketeer.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_capybara.jpg[/img][/td]
[td][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/10/avatar_inca_maceman.jpg[/img][/td]
[/tr][/table]
[b]▶︎ NEW REWARDS![/b]
[b]Starting TODAY through NOVEMBER 3,[/b] complete in-game tasks to unlock a ton of themed goodies:
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Musketeer[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b]

🔒 [b]Earn the “Imperial Age” achievement in [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i].[/b]
🏆 Unlocks a mod that replaces your [b]Hand Cannoneers[/b] with [b]Musketeers[/b].
💾 [b]Xbox Live Sign required in both games to verify achievement.[/b]
📝 [b]The mod must be activated manually in [i]Age II: DE[/i] when unlocked.[/b][/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Play any standard game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Great Bombard Statue[/b] Town Center mod.

🔒 [b]Herd 8 livestock in one single- or multiplayer game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Capybara[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Cumulatively deplete at least 5 berry bushes in games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Capybara Cannonball[/b] mod.

🔒 [b]Kill 5 enemy villagers in one game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Inca Maceman[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Cumulatively build at least 50 farms in games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Age III Gunpowder Audio[/b] mod.
[/code]
[b]▶︎ KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] at any point during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve unlocked! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the celebration!

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue where Villagers which began working before the discovery of the [b]Wheelbarrow[/b] and [b]Hand Cart[/b] would not be issued the tools, and thus would not benefit from their increased efficiency, until re-tasked.
[*] Restarting a scenario which enables the [b]‘Villager Force Drop’[/b] setting will no longer activate that setting in standard games when tasking Villagers to collect another resource.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where Villagers would not collect the full resource value from a mine. An example is where a stone mine would be depleted after collecting 349 of the 350 stone normally available.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where buildings would disappear in the fog of war layer of certain campaign missions with the “shared visibility” flag enabled.
[*] Units in the "Land Battles" Art of War scenario will no longer be invisible (and consequently, counterproductive to teaching the concepts at hand)—another symptom of the above bug.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed a rare issue where the Extreme AI would, without any strategic reasoning or clear benefit, choose to deploy units to the left corner of the map.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the Extreme AI would, in certain circumstances, adopt a passive, non-violent philosophy of war until attacked.
[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]
[list][*] [b]sn-enable-patrol-attack[/b] now works correctly in combination with [b]Town Size Attacks (TSA)[/b].[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Audio mods will now take effect immediately without the need to restart the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where modifying a unit's voice for a single civilization would silence that unit's voice for any other civilizations not also present in the mod package.[/list]

[quote]Please note that custom mods may not be compatible with the latest game update. If you are experiencing issues launching or playing the game after downloading the new build, try [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/mods]disabling your installed mods[/url] before trying again.

Still having trouble? Visit our [url=https://support.ageofempires.com/hc/]support page[/url]![/quote]

notes.title: An Update from the CaptureAge Team!
notes.notes:
Veterans of [i]Age of Empires II[/i] saw how CaptureAge (CA) evolved during the lifespan of the original game: adding new features over time and growing to suit the needs of the community. With the release of the [i]Definitive Edition[/i], and in [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/we-and-ca-partnership/]partnership with World’s Edge[/url], the team behind CaptureAge has now built a new tool to help players and enthusiasts of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] spectate matches with ease. Today, we’re excited to share the progress being made on the next iteration of the CaptureAge tool: [b]CaptureAge Preview![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/ecd5ab741489aa402c4a139500ac9cc47cc4785b.png[/img]

CaptureAge Preview is the latest version of the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] overlay, and introduces three major additions for casters and viewers:

[quote][h1]PRODUCTION QUEUE[/h1]
Instead of showing how many of each unit is being queued, the HUD will now display the number of production buildings along with their production activity. Army compositions have also been refined and focused, and now display the primary unit and up to two additional, supporting units. This replaces the full army list—focusing instead on the primary makeup of a player’s forces rather than the straggler spearman the player built back in the Feudal Age to counter a Scout rush.[/quote]
[quote][h1]“NEXT AGE” PROGRESS[/h1]
“Age” is in the name of the game. In addition to showing player progress towards the next Age, we are also showing the progress towards clicking up to the next age by displaying the Food, Gold, and building requirements/counts right next to it.[/quote]
[quote][h1]SMALLER UI[/h1]
The Hidden Cup 3 overlay was designed with mobile devices in mind, but viewers have noted that it now feels too large. As a result, the text and panel size has been reduced slightly—maximizing the amount of action on screen while still being viewable on lower resolutions and smaller screens.
[/quote]
Starting today, the CaptureAge team is interested in hearing YOUR feedback about these changes! This week, you can view the new overlay put to use by three community shoutcasters—[url=https://www.twitch.tv/membtv]MembTV[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/nili_aoe]NiliAoE[/url], and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/t90official]T90Official[/url]—with plans to add more in the following weeks!
[list][*] [i]Do you like the changes?[/i]
[*] [i]Do you think this is not the right direction?[/i]
[*] [i]Do you have an idea you’d like to see included in the overlay?[/i][/list]
Give it a look and then join the discussion on the official CaptureAge Twitch, on reddit—where they discuss the latest features and feedback—and on the official CaptureAge Discord!
[list][*] [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/CaptureAge/]CA on Reddit[/url]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/nMUaFUM]CA on Discord[/url]
[*] [url=http://www.twitch.tv/CaptureAge]CA on Twitch[/url][/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 40874
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e34f3e217f51eef44136119605aa0cede3c173e1.png[/img]

GOOD DAY and HAPPY SEPTEMBER, everyone!

This month’s update continues the trend of introducing a smaller (though nonetheless significant) list of tweaks, fixes, and changes to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. While brand-new features and additions are subjected to rigorous testing in preparation for the quarterly update, this month’s release still brings its own list of fixes and features to the game, as well as a new event with exclusive rewards to earn, and even a new challenge scenario for you to show off your skills to your friends!

Here’s the short (tl;dr) list of changes:
[list][*] Unlock new profile icons, mods, and an exclusive cheat code during the [b]Teutons Event![/b]
[*] Hold out against waves of enemies in the [b]Barbarossa Brawl[/b] challenge scenario!
[*] Implemented several pathfinding improvements for Villagers.
[*] [b]Gates[/b] will no longer permanently lock in the “open” position.
[*] Adjustments to the Arabia, Bog Islands, Fortress, Megarandom, Scandinavia, and Socotra maps.[/list]
The full, detailed list can be found below: give it a read, experiment with things in the game, and then let us know what you think about the September Update! We’re always perusing our forums for the latest discussions and chatting with you over in the game channels on Discord, so keep all the amazing feedback and inspiration coming our way!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
That’s it for this month! We hope you enjoy everything and look forward to seeing you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1]▬▬▬ UPDATE 40874 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with this month's update:

[h3][b]The Teutons Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=IOrwpzR8oRQ;full][/previewyoutube][code][h3]🤍 September 22 – October 6[/h3][/code]This month, we’re celebrating the [b]Teutons[/b] with a new CELEBRATION, new REWARDS, a never-before-seen CHEAT CODE, and an all-new CHALLENGE SCENARIO to test your [i]Age of Empires II[/i] skills. We’ve jam-packed it with a ton of Oktoberfest spirit, so get in there and join us for Teu-TONS of fun!
[list][*]  Unlock three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Unlock a new [b]Teutonic Knight statue[/b] as the jewel of your Town Center!
[*] Discover a new cheat code: [b]“Put on your capes”[/b]
[*] Bury your enemy in [b]Pretzel Projectiles[/b] with a new [b]Onager mod![/b]
[*] Test your survival skills in the new [b]Barbarossa Brawl scenario![/b][/list]
[b]▶︎ NEW REWARDS![/b]
[b]Starting TODAY through OCTOBER 6,[/b] complete in-game tasks to unlock a ton of themed goodies:
[code]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Teutonic Knight in Lederhosen[/b] profile icon.
💾 [b]*Required* if you want to save any rewards unlocked during the event![/b][/code]Each of the following challenges must be unlocked in order and on separate days:
[code]🔒 [b]Survive the Teuton Challenge for 10 minutes[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Teutonic Knight Statue Town Center[/b] mod.

🔒 [b]Train 20 Teutonic Knights in Standard or Multiplayer games[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Villager in Dirndl[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Win a Standard or Multiplayer game while playing as the Teutons[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]“Put on your capes”[/b] cheat code (single player only), which replaces all infantry units with Elite Teutonic Knights.

🔒 [b]Survive the Teuton Challenge for 20 minutes[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Siege Tower filled with Teutonic Knights[/b] profile icon.

🔒 [b]Capture a relic in the Teuton Challenge[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Onager Pretzel Projectiles[/b] mod.
[/code]
[b]▶︎ KEEP IT FOREVER!![/b]
Remember: if you [b]sign in to Xbox Live[/b] at any point during the event, you’ll get to keep all of the [b]mods[/b] and [b]profile icons[/b] you’ve unlocked! Sign in, earn your rewards, and enjoy the Summer Celebration Event!

[h3][b]NEW! Barbarossa Brawl (Challenge Scenario)[/b][/h3]Come, one and all, to test your skills in the [b]BARBAROSSA BRAWL![/b]
[list][*] [b]Build up your defenses[/b] and prepare for an intense siege!

This special holdout scenario challenges you with increasingly more dangerous opponents in an endless siege of your Town Center. The longer you can hold out, the more points you’ll earn towards a spot on the leaderboard of your friends!

While this does come at a cost of your game’s performance, it’s immensely helpful to generate logs if you know you are prone to connection issues.
[list][*] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoe2de-update-40874#BUILD-SPOTLIGHT_elb]More information about the Enhanced Logging Build can be found here![/url][/list]

[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] Players now start with a Mill and five extra Villagers next to their deer on Empire Wars—thus restoring the starting economic population to the standard [b]27[/b] units.

[quote][h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief update from our Production team regarding some of what is still in the works:

This will generate advanced logs that you can share to help us better understand why you’re experiencing these problems.[/list]

Happy summer, [i]Age[/i] friends! All around the northern hemisphere, we’re soaking up the summer sun (responsibly) while trying to capture and bring a little of that warmth and happiness to [i]Age of Empires II[/i]—and what better way to do that than with an all-new [b]Summer Celebration[/b] and a new update!

This month’s update is focused on the stability and playability of the game—based largely on feedback and input from the community following the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2572068948295461441]July update[/url]. It’s smaller than many of our previous updates, but includes several important changes to the game:
[list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]Gates[/b] could not be constructed at certain angles.
[*] Fixed a crash triggered when several selected units were killed at the same time while spectating.
[*] Players should no longer matchmake on the [b]Brazi[/b]l server if they are not playing in a region where it makes sense to do so.
[*] Placement of resources in random maps is no longer constrained to cardinal directions.[/list]
Next month should be similar in scale as we amass changes to release in a larger, quarterly update. As always: what shows up each month depends largely on your input, so don’t be afraid to get involved in the community! Whether you want to start or join a conversation on the forum or bounce ideas off other players on Discord, we want to talk with you and hear what you’d like to see in [i]Age of Empires II[/i].

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/7525e15f9535d9203fce9d94792d7254822d7bbd.png[/img]

Today’s hotfix follows in the footsteps of [b]Update 39284[/b] with a handful of important fixes for issues that cropped up in last week’s build. This includes the notable pauses during gameplay, AI behaviors that proved disruptive to players, the loss of the final chapter in the Saladin campaign, a misrepresentation of ELO changes following ranked matches, and more.

Note that there are still a number of issues which are still being investigated—such as the inability to construct certain gates, reported problems with the Brazil server, and others—and we will do what we can to keep you updated and informed as we work towards solutions. For the time, keep an eye on the Known Issues page and official forum for updates and requests for more information from those experiencing the problems.

[quote]📃 [b]LEARN ABOUT:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/2572068948295461441]Update 39284[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/104]On the Official Forum[/url]
❓ [b]FIND:[/b] [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]Other Known Issues[/url][/quote]
