—The Age of Empires Team

[h1]▬▬▬ HOTFIX 39515 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ FIXES ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Fixed an issue which caused intermittent, short pauses during gameplay.
[*] Fixed an issue where ELO changes would not be displayed properly after the conclusion of each ranked match.
[*] Fixed an issue where broken mods could prevent the title from launching.
[*] Fixed an issue which resulted in the removal of the [b]Saladin 6 (“The Lion and the Demon”)[/b] campaign mission—leading to great historical turmoil!
[*] The [b]Horse[/b] unit now has the same speed, armor class, and line of sight as the [b]Scout Cavalry[/b] unit.
[*] The Department of Agriculture has cited villagers who would attempt to replant farms well beyond their allotted plots. This should result in less wandering across the map to seek out unoccupied plots.
[*] Farmers will now automatically split to nearby farms that are free when they finish building a new farm.
[*] Players will no longer be matched on maps that are not in the current map pool.
[*] Fixed an issue in Ranked play where Black Forest would launch unexplored, and other maps would show up as explored when not intended.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI-controlled players would fail to lure boars in certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a visual issue with the rendering of ranked map tabs.[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition July 2020 Update
notes.notes:
People may be looking towards Age of Empires 3's remake & the long-awaited Age of Empires 4, but Age of Empires 2 is still alive and kicking. The Definitive Edition has just received a big update.

The highlights include balance improvements to over 23 different maps, separate Random Map & Deathmatch map pools, a new map, and a bunch of little tweaks and stat/cost changes.

There's a new Mongol Civ event happening, with a new competitive single-player map. The community is also able to vote on which maps they want in the two map pools.

Here's' a video talking about the new changes:

And here's the full summary of the update from the patch notes page:

Ranked Matchmaking updates! Separate Random Map & Deathmatch map pools; new 'Preferred Map' and 'Prefer Random Civilization' option in lobbies! Various balance changes and bug fixes to 6 civilizations and several campaigns! A long list of map improvements to over 23 maps! AI Improvements! Pathfinding improvements! The Horde of Genghis Khan approaches during the Mongol Civ Event! NEW MAP: Land Nomad!284 New competitive Single Player scenario! New 'player lookup' functionality in Profile menu!

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] AI-controlled players may now delete a wall tile (and reconstruct it later) in order to more effectively lure a boar from outside of a walled base.
[*] AI players may now delete and abandon building foundations located next to enemy fortifications (such as a Castle, Krepost, Tower, etc.).
[*] AI players may now inform their allies about enemy player positions by sending a chat message and using a flare on the minimap.
[*] Players can now (properly) change the attack stance of converted scouting units previously owned by an AI player.
[*] Updated the AI build orders to enable a smoother progression curve.
[*] Updated the AI player response to Eagle Warrior rushes.
[*] AI-controlled Scouts can now path to the edge of the map to capture sheep.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented AI players from training the most effective units to counter specific enemy compositions.
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the AI to send too many Villagers to defend against a Tower rush.
[*] Implemented a variety of minor fixes and strategical improvements to the AI player behavior.
[*] Improved the behavior of the AI (CD) when assigned to the new [i]Definitive Edition[/i] civilizations (Lithuanians, Bulgarians, Cumans, and Tatars).[/list]
Some adjustments have also been made to the Extreme AI behavior:
[list][*] Extreme AI players may preemptively send Spearmen to resource drop sites to protect gatherers when enemy cavalry attacks are expected.[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] Improved the behavior of melee units as they surround and clash with tightly-packed armies—such as when cavalry units surround and try to attack a death-ball of archers.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] AI: [b]up-group-size[/b] count no longer includes garrisoned objects.
[*] AI: Fixed an issue which could cause [b]up-change-name[/b] to load the wrong script when restarting the game.
[*] AI: [b]up-find-status-remote/local[/b] now stacks searches correctly.
[*] AI: [b]up-get-focus-fact[/b] and [b]up-get-target-fact[/b] now work correctly when getting allied goal values.
[*] AI: [b]up-find-remote c: gate-class[/b] can now find gates.
[*] AI: [b]up-get-path-distance/up-path-distance[/b] will return 65535 if the unit cannot actually path to destination tile.
[*] AI: [b]position-enemy[/b] and [b]position-target[/b] now work correctly.
[*] AI: [b]object-data-patrolling[/b] will no longer always return 0.
[*] AI: [b]up-get-focus-fact[/b] and [b]up-get-target-fact[/b] now return the correct value when using player-distance.
[*] AI: [b]up-find-remote[/b] will no longer find pending objects when using class.
[*] AI: [b]object-data-idling[/b] now works correctly with livestock.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Added a [b]Datamod[/b] drop-down menu to the Campaign screens.
[*] Modded music will no longer be played louder than original tracks.
[*] Moved the storage location of cursor (.cur) files to [b]resources/_common/cursors[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3][list][*] Removed duplicate techs from the editor tech list.
[*] Fixed an issue where diplomacy would always display as “enemy” when playing a scenario in a Standard Game. This was caused by Diplomacy Settings not being properly saved in the scenario, and can be fixed by opening and re-saving any affected scenarios so the fix can take effect.[/list]

Good day, everyone! Today's hotfix addresses several critical issues and is now available for download. Be sure that the numbers [b]37906[/b] can be found at the bottom the game lobby screen to ensure you are on the latest game build.

Thank you for your patience, and please let us know if you spot any new issues in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/]discussions forum[/url].

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1]▬▬▬ UPDATE 37906 ▬▬▬[/h1]

[h1]◆ FIXES ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an [b]AoEURLInstaller_Steam.exe/VCRUNTIME140_1.dll[/b] error that would appear after updating to game build 37650 (the May update).
[*] Fixed a crash when joining [b]3v3[/b] or [b]4v4 Ranked Matches[/b].

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 37650
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EE3msNcJD14;full][/previewyoutube]
Good day, fellow tacticians!

May marks the six-month milestone since the arrival of [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] this past November, and we’re just as excited today as we were on day one—even as we now work, play, and enjoy the game from the safety of our homes. We hope you’re staying healthy, safe, and taking the time to play and escape from the world when it’s needed the most!

Today’s update introduces new changes, content, and improvements to keep up with our growing community: including a new [b]in-game event[/b] to test your skills as well as major improvements to the [b]stability[/b] and [b]playability[/b] of the game. Here's the tl;dr list of the highlights:
[list][*] Fixed the infamous [b]“5 Minute Disconnect!”[/b]
[*] The [b]Malay[/b] now prioritize speed over stamina when Aging Up!
[*] Implemented various [b]balance changes[/b] and [b]fixes[/b] for civilizations, units, and maps!
[*] Improved the [b]AI[/b] to put up a better fight (or be a better partner) on the battlefield!
[*] Added several [b]localization fixes[/b] for several languages!
[*] Introducing the [b]May-hem Event[/b]: celebrating the quirkiness of [i]Age of Empires II[/i]![/list]
As always, the full list of changes can be found below while the conversation happens over on our community channels!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 37650 Discussion[/url][/quote]
Be safe, everyone, and we hope you enjoy the latest changes to [i]Age of Empires II![/i]

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 37650 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of notable fixes and features to which to look forward in today’s build, here are some of the big highlights coming with the May update:

[h3][b]The May-hem Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=qykw2Q_IVY8;full][/previewyoutube]
It's that time again! With the May update comes a brand-new festival for you to enjoy—[b]THE "MAY-HEM" EVENT[/b]—when we're celebrating the love of the game by spotlighting the community's unique approaches, discoveries, and favorite moments in [i]Age of Empires[/i] over the last 20+ years.

Here’s what we’ve pulled together for you to enjoy during the event:
[list][*] Three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Three [b]event-exclusive visual mods![/b]
[*] Train your [b]sheep[/b] to be even better scouts!
[*] Discover unique, Age-themed Easter Eggs hidden in the game!
[*] Unlock the new [b]Mayhem Menu Background[/b] for the duration of the event.[/list]
Starting [b]TODAY[/b] through [b]JUNE 9[/b], check back daily to unlock new challenges and new event content:

[quote]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem La Hire[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Play the ‘Early Economy’ Art of War mission and obtain a Silver or Gold medal.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Town Center Trophies Decoration[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train at least three monks.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem Scout Sheep[/b] profile icon and the [b]Monk Unit Conversion FX[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train at least 99 villagers over the course of any number of games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Calculating Research FX[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Build at least 20 wall sections over the course of any number of games.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Mayhem Teuton[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Use a sheep to scout an animal.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Sheep Scouting[/b] behavior: your sheep will magically learn the [b]auto-scout[/b] ability in campaign missions and single player matches.[/quote]
There are also four new Easter Eggs to seek out in the game—two of which are permanent additions! Can you find them all?

[quote]🔲 🐘 ???

🔲 👑 ???

🔲 🥌 ??? [i](Event Exclusive)[/i]

🔲 🕚 ??? [i](Event Exclusive)[/i][/quote]
Don’t forget to [b]sign into Xbox Live[/b]; doing so will ensure that you get to keep all the mods and profile icons you unlock during the event! We hope you enjoy this celebration of the community, as well as everything else coming with today’s update!

[h3][b]The "5-Minute Disconnect" Fix[/b][/h3]After months of back-and-forth collaboration with the community, we’ve managed to isolate and implement several fixes for the notorious [b]“5-Minute Disconnect”[/b] issue
[list][*] Fixed an issue which resulted in specific routers disconnecting from the servers 4-5 minutes after starting a match.[/list]
The team worked hard to uncover all of the potential causes of the problem, but could not have reached this conclusion without the help of those affected. [b]We appreciate the time and energy spent by everyone who participated in the conversation, shared their experience with the issue, or who simply kept us updated about its impact on the community![/b]

[quote]Please note that local ISP and hardware issues can still result in disconnects from the game—we have, unfortunately, not solved “the internet” ([i]at least, not yet[/i]). Please continue to report new issues that impact your ability to play: making sure to include your network information, logs, and any other relevant details. We will continue to monitor for these reports and work to improve things on our end.[/quote]
[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The game will no longer crash when using the “marco,” “polo,” or “i r winner” cheat codes when playing a custom campaign.
[*] Implemented fixes to address a variety of crashes.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where players could research technologies instantaneously, at no cost, and/or more than once.
[*] The [b]Malay[/b] now properly advance through the Ages [b]66% faster[/b] than other civs instead of with 166% more style.
[*] Doubled the maximum [b]scrolling speed[/b] threshold for players who want to see more of the map in less time.
[*] [b]Siege Workshops[/b] constructed next to walls can no longer be used to spawn units on the opposite side of said walls in certain circumstances.
[*] Khmer [b]Villagers[/b] will now continue constructing houses after garrisoning and being sent back to work.
[*] Fixed a visual issue where the rubble of destroyed buildings could be seen through the Fog of War.
[*] Fixed an issue where attacking the sides (aka the “gatehouse towers” or “barbicans”) of a gate would not trigger the attack notification sound.
[*] Fixed a rare issue which allowed units to be queued and trained at the wrong building.
[*] Dolphins will no longer remain on the map once they’ve been depleted. ([i]“So long, and thanks for the food!”[/i])[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The [b]Homeless[/b] achievement can now only be unlocked when a player wins a game after deleting their starting Town Center. This addresses an issue where it could be earned without fulfilling the requirements.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Supplies[/b] technology is no longer available to the [b]Chinese, Cumans, Huns, Khmer, Lithuanians, Mayans, Mongols[/b], and [b]Tatars[/b].
[*] [b]Watch Towers[/b] can no longer be built in the [b]Dark Age[/b] if one is automatically generated at the start of the match (e.g. on the Fortress map).
[*] [b]Hussar:[/b] Reduced the length of the attack animation from [b]1.89[/b] to [b]1.35 seconds[/b] (equivalent to Light Cavalry). This [i]does not[/i] increase their DPS, but improves their ability to chase and harass targets.[/list]
[h3][b]Aztecs[/b][/h3][list][*] The civilization bonus which decreases the training time of military units now does so by [b]10%[/b] (was 15%).[/list]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3][list][*] The bonuses granted by the [b]Manipur Cavalry[/b] upgrade are no longer partially-blocked by the [b]Masonry[/b] tech.[/list]
[h3][b]Indians[/b][/h3][list][*] The team bonus to damage dealt by Camels to structures is no longer blocked by the [b]Masonry[/b] or [b]Architecture[/b] upgrades, and now applies to all buildings, as intended.[/list]
[b]▶︎ UNITS[/b][list][*] [b]Elephant Archer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the reload time of attacks from [b]2.5[/b] to [b]2.0 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the cost to train from [b]80[/b] to [b]70 gold[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Mayans[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]El Dorado:[/b] Increased the time to research the upgrade from [b]50[/b] to [b]70 seconds[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Saracens[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Zealotry:[/b] Reduced the cost to research the upgrade from [b]800[/b] to [b]700 gold[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGNS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] [b]Objective timers[/b] are now displayed properly after re-loading a saved game.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The way starting [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes are generated has been revised to prevent situations where they fail to spawn entirely.
[*] Updated how [b]straggler trees[/b] are generated so they don’t straggle right next to forests.
[*] Updated how [b]predator animals[/b] are generated on several maps.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Continental:[/b] Extra [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes have been adjusted to spawn per player in 1v1 maps.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Adjusted the generation of starting [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] to prevent them from appearing right next to a player’s Town Center.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] The way [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] nodes are generated has been revised to prevent situations where they fail to spawn completely.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] Acacia trees have been replaced by [b]Dragon[/b] and [b]Palm[/b] trees.
[*] [b]Islands:[/b] The fifth relic spawned in a 1v1 match now appears on one of the small islands in the middle of the map.
[*] [b]Nomad:[/b] The logic when generating shore fish has been updated to distribute the nodes more evenly.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Increased the starting food for each player by spawning four additional goats and two shore fish per person.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Slightly increased the number of forested and mountain slope areas generated on the map.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Distributed the extra gold nodes more evenly among players.
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro:[/b] Starting fish will now appear further from where berries have sprouted in the map.
[*] [b]Ravines:[/b] The starting food on the map has been updated to include: [b]10 Ibexes, 10 Geese[/b], and [b]6 Berry Bushes[/b].
[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] Adjusted the natural balance of predators on the map. Bears and wolves now claim their own territories and have organized in more consistently-sized groups.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]number_of_tiles[/b] and [b]land_percent[/b] commands no longer create larger lands than intended. (This affected a few standard maps, such as Arena.)[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Removed the grace period where players could resign from a ranked match without losing ELO points.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented players from joining another multiplayer lobby after playing a custom scenario in the same session.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented player chat from appearing when playing a custom multiplayer scenario.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=sh4Z1G2NWZU;full][/previewyoutube]
[code]Maps unique to each map pool are in [b]bold[/b].[/code]
The [b]1v1[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Bog Islands[/b]
[*] [b]Continental[/b]
[*] [b]Golden Pit[/b]
[*] Hill Fort
[*] [b]Kilimanjaro[/b]
[*] MegaRandom
[*] [b]Mountain Pass[/b][/list]
The [b]Team[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Black Forest[/b]
[*] Hill Fort
[*] [b]Lombardia[/b]
[*] MegaRandom
[*] [b]Nomad[/b]
[*] [b]Scandinavia[/b]
[*] [b]Wolf Hill[/b][/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Added the first iteration of a new AI strategy: [b]Fast Imperial Age![/b] Allied computer players will now enact the strategy when deemed appropriate, or can be motivated by allies with [b]Taunt 95[/b].
[*] Based on player feedback, several minor adjustments have been made to how AI players scale in regards to their difficulty setting.
[*] Implemented several improvements to how AI-controlled players behave on migration-style maps. This includes checks to avoid abandoning their Scout unit or idling their Villagers after moving to a new land.
[*] Improved how the computer responds to enemy tower rushes. AI players will now actively defend themselves with villagers and defensive structures, when possible.
[*] Added logic to prevent situations where the AI would play overly-passive at the very wrong times.
[*] At higher difficulty levels, AI-controlled military will now retreat outside of the range of enemy fortifications when appropriate.
[*] Implemented several improvements to the AI’s strategic decision-making in an effort to make it more efficient.
[*] Improved the ability of the AI to adapt to unorthodox map layouts.
[*] Improved the way AI players communicate with teammates: including how they respond to taunts and the messages they send in chat.[/list]
In addition to the above changes, we’ve made several adjustments to the computer logic when set to the [b]Extreme[/b] difficulty:
[list][*] Fixed several instances where an AI-controlled player would surrender despite still having strong allies.
[*] AI players will now pick their fights more effectively: taking less engagements when they are at a disadvantage.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]up-get-object-type-data[/b] now functions with units which are not available.
[*] Added new [b]object-data[/b] commands to collect [b]capture flag[/b] and [b]capture object[/b] information:
[list][*] [b]object-data-ownership[/b] is ID 83
[*] [b]object-data-capture-flag[/b] is ID 84[/list]
[*] The AI can now task heroes to explore in non-scenario matches.
[*] [b]up-remaining-boar-amount[/b] now returns [b]65535[/b] if there is no valid boar.
[*] [b]up-retreat-to[/b] now supports unit lines.
[*] [b]load-random[/b] now works as intended.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]UI[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Continued making adjustments to the in-game profanity filter to better-cater to the communication styles of the [i]Age[/i] audience.
[*] Adjusted how icons are displayed when the [b]“Display Future Items”[/b] option is enabled to better-distinguish between those that are not yet available and those that cannot be afforded.
[*] Implemented a setting to [b]mute[/b] or [b]continue playing[/b] the game’s audio when the application is not in focus.
[*] The post-game timeline can no longer be modded to display during a match while it is still being played. It can, however, still be accessed during replays and spectator mode, and will no longer crash the game upon conclusion of the match.
[*] Fixed an issue where the in-game chat would not be displayed in recorded games.
[*] Limited the framerate of out-of-game menus to 60 FPS.[/list]
[h3][b]Localization[/b][/h3][b]▶︎ GENERAL[/b][list][*] Taunts 7, 9, 11, and 26 will now use the original localized audio when possible.[/list]
[b]▶︎ CHINESE[/b][list][*] Corrected sentences where “unlocked” was mistranslated as “not unlocked”
[*] Updated the name of the [b]Turkish[/b] language in the settings menu.
[*] Corrected multiple text strings where the punctuation displayed at the start of the line rather than the end.
[*] Corrected a text/audio mismatch in the following Art of War missions:
[list][*] [b]Destroying a Castle[/b]
[*] [b]Land Battle[/b][/list][/list]
[b]▶︎ FRENCH[/b][list][*] Updated the translation of [b]Men at Arms[/b] to be consistent throughout the game.
[*] Corrected errors in the hint text for the [b]Destroying a Castle[/b] (Art of War) scenario.
[*] ‘Spain Spanish’ is no longer described as ‘Latin American Spanish’ in the language settings.
[*] Added translations for the [b]Menu Narration[/b] and [b]Chat Narration[/b] settings in the Audio menu.[/list]
[b]▶︎ GERMAN[/b][list][*] Updated the text of the [b]Fire with Fire[/b] achievement to accurately reflect its requirements.[/list]
[b]▶︎ HINDI[/b][list][*] Fixed the truncation of Hindi characters on the main menu.[/list]
[b]▶︎ ITALIAN[/b][list][*] Updated the faction team names throughout the [b]Genghis Khan 1 (‘Crucible’)[/b] mission.
[*] Updated the faction team names throughout the [b]Montezuma 2 (‘The Triple Alliance’)[/b] mission so as to remain consistent.
[*] Updated references to the city of [b]Naissus[/b] (was Naisso).
[*] Updated the translation of the [b]Genitour[/b] unit to be consistent throughout the game.
[*] Updated the name of a hut in the [b]Pachacuti 3 (‘War of Brothers’)[/b] mission that would always display its name in English.
[*] The name, [b]Basarab[/b], is now spelled correctly throughout the Dracula campaign.
[*] The hotkey settings used to [b]Create Group[/b] and [b]Select Group[/b] have been updated for consistency.
[*] Updated the translation for [b]Group Commands[/b] in the hotkeys menu.
[*] Updated the translation for the [b]Chain Mail Armor[/b] technology.
[*] Fixed several instances of truncated text in the multiplayer tabs.
[*] Fixed overlapping text on the Diplomacy screen.
[*] Updated and corrected the [b]hint text[/b] and [b]scouting reports[/b] for the following missions:
[list][*] [b]Genghis Khan 1 (‘Crucible’)[/b]
[*] [b]Montezuma 2 (‘The Triple Alliance’)[/b]

[*] [b]Tamerlane 1 (‘Amir of Transoxiana’)[/b]
[*] [b]Yodit 1 (‘Path of Exile’)[/b][/list]
[*] Corrected a text/audio mismatch during the opening slideshow of the following campaign missions:
[list][*] [b]Genghis Khan 1 (‘Crucible’)[/b]

[*] [b]Tamerlane 4 (‘Sultan of Hindustan’)[/b][/list][/list]

[*] Corrected a text/audio mismatch in the following Art of War missions:
[list][*] [b]Battle Formations[/b]
[*] [b]Land Battle[/b][/list][/list]
[b]▶︎ PORTUGUESE[/b][list][*] Fixed an issue where the “Full Tech Tree” label would overlap other UI elements.
[*] Corrected a text/audio mismatch in the following Art of War missions:
[list][*] Battle Formations
[*] [b]Destroying a Castle[/b]
[*] [b]Land Battle[/b]
[*] [b]Naval Battle[/b][/list][/list]
[b]▶︎ SPANISH (LATIN AMERICAN)[/b][list][*] Updated the translation of [b]Mangonels[/b] to be consistent throughout the game.
[*] Updated the translation of [b]“range”[/b] to be consistent throughout the Tech Tree.
[*] Added the attack bonus to the descriptive text of the [b]Recurve Bow[/b] technology.
[*] Removed a redundant word from the description of the [b]Kipchak[/b] unit.[/list]
[b]▶︎ SPANISH (SPAIN)[/b][list][*] The Spanish word, “tú,” is no longer missing its accent.
[*] Updated the translated name of the [b]Elite Camel Archer[/b] unit.
[*] Revised the translated text on the Scouting tab of the [b]Honfoglalás[/b] scenario.
[*] Added localized hint text that was missing from the [b]Dracula 3 (‘The Breath of the Dragon’)[/b] mission.
[*] Updated the Scouting reports for several campaign missions that were displaying information from an incorrect source.
[*] Updated the descriptions of numerous buildings and weapons that were displaying information from an incorrect source.
[*] Updated the translation of the following items to ensure consistency throughout the game: [b]Trebuchet, Fire Galley, Food, Genoese Crossbowman, Knight, Longboat, Multiplayer, Siege Workshop, Skirmisher, Stable, Steppe Lancer, Town Center[/b][/list]
[b]▶︎ TURKISH[/b][list][*] Updated the [b]History[/b] section to properly list civilizations in alphabetical order based on the Turkish language (rather than the English language).
[*] Tooltip text is now properly localized in Turkish.
[*] Updated the name of the [b]Spanish[/b] language in the settings menu.[/list]
[b]▶︎ VIETNAMESE[/b][list][*] Updated and corrected the introductory text in the following Art of War scenarios:
[list][*] [b]Battle Formations[/b]
[*] [b]Destroying a Castle[/b]
[*] [b]Naval Battle[/b]
[*] [b]Rushing the Enemy[/b]
[*] [b]Defending Against a Rush[/b][/list][/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GRAPHICS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a rare issue where particle effects (such as fires) would appear in the wrong places.
[*] [b]Bombard Cannons[/b] now have the correct anchor point, allowing them to reorient themselves more gracefully.
[*] Fixed an issue with color corruption during the [b]Dock[/b] destruction animations.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]SCENARIO EDITOR[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Players can now select and copy the last generated map seed by switching to seed mode within the Editor.[/list]
[b]▶︎ TERRAIN[/b][list][*] [b]Map Copy:[/b] The paint brush now has the same dimensions as the copied area.
[*] [b]Map Copy:[/b] Now properly copies over garrisoned objects.[/list]
[b]▶︎ TRIGGERS[/b][list][*] The [b]Facet[/b] property of the [b]Create Object[/b] trigger now works with (and defaults to) -1 as a set value.
[*] The [b]Modify Attribute[/b] trigger now remembers the attribute even after updating the [b]Quantity[/b] field.[/list]

[quote][h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief overview of some of the issues that have been raised for which we are actively working on solutions:
[list][*] [b]DISCONNECTS:[/b] We’ve made further changes that should improve connectivity for players—especially those who have been experiencing disconnects early on in Multiplayer matches. We’ll be monitoring these changes and gathering additional information where needed to help us follow-up and address additional bugs where we can find them.
[*] [b]COMMUNITY REPORTED ISSUES:[/b] For the past several months, we’ve been working through and resolving issues reported by you (the players). Please continue to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]visit our forums[/url] and let us know if you run into bugs while playing [i]AoEII:DE[/i]—we prioritize your reports as we look at what we can do to fix them.
[*] [b]PATHFINDING:[/b] We’re aware of instances where melee units aren’t pathing appropriately when engaging stacks of enemy armies, and we’ll be working on addressing this in a future update.[/list]
For other known issues, please visit [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!

[code][h3]:alertalert: DISCLAIMER[/h3]Please note that this list is subject to change, and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].[/code][/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 36906
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Kohpi-VGyLo;full][/previewyoutube]
Good day and happy April, battle historians!

This month’s introduces a ton of new changes and features to the game, some new civilization tweaks to bring some of the powerhouses into line (while lifting up some of the weaker civs), and an all new event for you to unlock new profile icons and skins for your account. Here are some of the big highlights:
[list][*] A brand-new [b]“Display Future Technologies”[/b] UI feature!
[*] New and improved [b]grid overlay[/b] options!
[*] Building and unit icons now match the player’s color.
[*] Various [b]balance changes and fixes[/b] for civilizations, units, and maps!
[*] Various [b]matchmaking[/b] fixes and improvements.
[*] Get your siege on during the [b]Medieval Technologies Event![/b][/list]
There’s a little something for everyone in this month’s release, though we’re not done yet; there is plenty more still in the works for [i]Age of Empires II[/i], including plenty of projects and fixes that we can’t wait to share with you. For now, we want to hear what you think about today’s build, as well as what you’d like to see included in the next update. Come join us on any one (or all) of our social channels and get involved in the conversation!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 36906 Discussion[/url][/quote]
We hope everyone is continuing to stay safe during these challenging times! Stay healthy, and we’ll see you on the battlefield! ❤

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- UPDATE 36906 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty of fixes and features coming with today’s build, here are some of the highlights to look for in the April update:

[h3][b]Greatest Medieval Technologies Event[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=E8oGGQQA_DQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Come one, come all! The [b]GREATEST MEDIEVAL TECHNOLOGIES EVENT[/b] is here to spotlight some of the most intimidating inventions in human history! From the evolution of siege technology to the advent of the crossbow, gunpowder, and even the defensive tools used to protect against these new technologies, we’re taking a closer look at the weapons of war that helped define and redefine the battlefields of their time.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/MedivalTech_Units_GIF_Small.gif[/img]

This month, you can play and complete challenges in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] to permanently unlock new icons, never before seen cheat codes, and cosmetics celebrating the greatest medieval technologies!
[list][*] Three new [b]Profile Icons![/b]
[*] Two new [b]Cheat Codes![/b]
[list][*] [b]“Going Above and Beyond:”[/b] Stack the benefits of your research up to 256 times
[*] [b]“Tech Tech One Two Free:“[/b] Why wait for invention when you can just remove those pesky research costs[/list]
[*] Three [b]exclusive visual mods![/b]
[list][*] Launch larger projectiles from Onagers, Mangonel, and Siege Onagers
[*] Show off your might with Golden Bombard Cannons
[*] Pew-pew in style with new tracer effects for the Hand Cannoneer, Janissary, and Conquistador[/list][/list]
[b]Today through May 13[/b], check back in-game to complete daily challenges and unlock all the new content:

[quote]🎯 [b]Sign into Xbox Live.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Crossbow[/b] profile icon.

🎯 [b]Train three Arbalesters in a single game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]‘Going Above and Beyond’[/b] cheat code.

🎯 [b]Research the Chain Mail technology.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Golden Bombard Cannon[/b] profile icon and the [b]‘larger Onagers projectiles’[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train three Fast Fire Ships in a single game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]‘gold skin for Bombard Cannon’[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Train three Bombard Cannons in a single game.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]Hand Cannon[/b] profile icon and the [b]‘tracer effects for gunpowder units’[/b] mod.

🎯 [b]Destroy an enemy Castle with a Trebuchet.[/b]
🏆 Unlocks the [b]‘Tech Tech One Two Free’[/b] cheat code.[/quote]
Don’t forget to log into Xbox Live at some point during the event to keep the mods, profile icons, and cheat codes you unlock during the event!

We hope you enjoy the best that medieval history has to provide: both with the celebration AND with [i]Age of Empires II[/i]!

[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed various crashes which could be triggered when spectating games.
[*] Fixed various one-off crashes.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]PERFORMANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The game client will no longer download additional localized versions of the [b]Art of War[/b] videos other than the selected language and English (as a backup). Excess variants have been removed, reducing the total size of the game’s installation by ~5GB.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]HD AI[/b] could not be selected as the AI Difficulty when using any language other than English.
[*] Added new hotkeys to select all [b]Markets[/b], all [b]Blacksmiths[/b], and all [b]Universities[/b].
[*] Added a new [b]“Dynamic Grid”[/b] option to the setting menu. This allows players to customize the shade and visual intensity of the grid that shows up in-game, as well as the circumstances under which it is displayed—such as when placing buildings, ordering ranged units, etc.

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/grid_appearance-288x141.png[/img]  [img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/grid_slider-288x141.png[/img]

[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Organ Guns[/b] were not always classified as siege weapons, thus allowing them to be converted without the [b]Redemption[/b] technology.
[*] Recorded games no longer break as soon as a player quits, drops, crashes, or otherwise departs from a match.
[*] Implemented additional tracking and safeguards to defend against cheat programs.[/list]
[h3][b]Chat Filtration[/b][/h3]We’ve made the transition to a new chat filtration back-end with the aim of better accommodating the needs of the [i]Age[/i] community. This update provides a less intrusive, more consistent experience across all platforms.
[list][*] Updated the profanity filter to be far less restrictive of normal and contextual (i.e. [i]Age of Empires[/i]-specific) chat.[/list]
As with everything else, this is a system that will continue to see changes and adjustments based on feedback from the community:
[list][*] [i]If it still feels too disruptive, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]let us know[/url].[/i]
[*] [i]If it is censoring “normal” conversation, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]let us know[/url]![/i][/list]
Keep the feedback coming, and thanks for continuing to work with us as we fine-tune the system!

[h1]◆ [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The [b]Age of Empires[/b] achievement—which requires players to win a match with every civilization—no longer requires players to [i]also[/i] win with the “Random” civilization option.
[*] The [b]Pitched Battle[/b] achievement is now correctly awarded when players complete ‘The Field of Blood’ mission (in the Pachacuti campaign) without constructing walls.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The civilization bonuses which provide additional villagers to the [b]Chinese[/b] and [b]Mayans[/b] and a bonus llama to the [b]Incas[/b] have been disabled in the [b]Empire Wars[/b] game mode.
[*] Fishermen can now drop food they’ve collected at [b]Docks[/b].
[*] [b]Fire Galley:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]60[/b] to [b]65 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Keshik [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Converted Keshiks now properly generate gold for their new overlords.[/list]
[h3][b]Bulgarians[/b][/h3][list][*] Can no longer research and train [b]Paladins[/b].
[*] The [b]Stirrups[/b] technology now affects all cavalry units, not just Light Cavalry and Konniks.[/list]
[h3][b]Ethiopians[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Torsion Engines:[/b] Increased the width of upgraded [b]Scorpion[/b] projectiles from [b]0.3[/b] to [b]0.5[/b] tiles.[/list]
[h3][b]Goths[/b][/h3][list][*] Now receive the [b]Loom[/b] technology for free as a civilization bonus.[/list]
[h3][b]Indians[/b][/h3][list][*] As a civilization bonus, [b]Fisherman[/b] now work [b]10%[/b] faster rather than working 15% faster and carrying +15 food.[/list]
[h3][b]Italians[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Fishing Ships[/b] now correctly cost [b]-15% wood[/b] (instead of -15 wood). This effectively raises the cost from [b]60[/b] to [b]64 wood[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Khmer[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the work rate of [b]Farmers[/b] by [b]3%[/b].
[*] Can no longer train [b]Bombard Cannons[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Lithuanians[/b][/h3][b]UNITS[/b][list][*] Leitis [Standard & Elite]: Adjusted the training cost from [b]50 food, 80 gold[/b] to [b]70 food, 50 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Leitis:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]23[/b] to [b]20 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Leitis:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]20[/b] to [b]18 seconds[/b].[/list]
[b]TECHNOLOGIES[/b][list][*] [b]Tower Shields:[/b] Reduced the cost to research from [b]800[/b] to [b]500 food[/b].
[*] [b]Tower Shields:[/b] Increased the bonus pierce armor provided to [b]Spearmen[/b] and [b]Skirmishers[/b] from [b]+1[/b] to [b]+2[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Malay[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Harbors[/b] now (properly) receive the benefits of [b]Chemistry, Murder Holes[/b], and [b]Heated Shot[/b] when [b]Thalassocracy[/b] is researched before any of these technologies.[/list]
[h3][b]Persians[/b][/h3][list][*] Removed the bonus to the work speed of [b]Town Centers[/b] and [b]Docks[/b] in the Dark Age. They now work: [b]10%[/b] faster (Feudal Age) →  [b]15%[/b] faster (Castle Age) →  [b]20%[/b] faster (Imperial Age)[/list]
[h3][b]Slavs[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Boyar [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced speed from [b]1.4[/b] to [b]1.3[/b].
[*] [b]Boyar [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Increased pierce armor by [b]+1[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Tatars[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Flaming Camels[/b] now benefit from the [b]+5 attack vs. buildings[/b] bonus provided by an [b]Indian[/b] ally.[/list]
[h3][b]Teutons[/b][/h3][list][*] As a civilization bonus, [b]Barracks[/b] and [b]Stable[/b] units now receive a [b]+1 melee armor[/b] bonus in the Castle and Imperial Age (+2 total).
[*] [b]Teutonic Knight:[/b] Increased speed from [b]0.7[/b] to [b]0.8[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Starting villagers and herdable animals should no longer spawn on the same tile.
[*] Reduced the number of wolves on all maps where they spawn.
[*] Distant cows and buffalo no longer appear in a single group on standard maps. They are now split into two groups comprised of two and one animal.[/list]
The elevation points have been revised and re-balanced on the following maps:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Baltic
[*] Budapest
[*] Cenotes
[*] City of Lakes
[*] Coastal
[*] Continental
[*] Crater Lake
[*] Enemy Archipelago
[*] Farout
[*] Fortress
[*] Four Lakes
[*] Ghost Lake
[*] Gold Rush [i](Partially)[/i]
[*] Hideout
[*] Highland
[*] Hill Fort
[*] InnerCircle
[*] Journey South
[*] JungleLanes
[*] Lombardia
[*] Mediterranean
[*] Migration
[*] Mongolia
[*] MotherLand
[*] Nomad
[*] Oasis
[*] OpenPlains
[*] Ring of Water
[*] Rivers
[*] Scandinavia
[*] Socotra
[*] Serengeti
[*] SnakePit
[*] Team Islands
[*] The Eye
[*] Valley
[*] YingYang
[*] Yucatan[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Fixed a rare bug where the starting stone nodes could fail to spawn.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Separated the original 7-tile gold group into one 4-tile and one 3-tile gold group.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Separated the original 5-tile stone group into one 3-tile and one 2-tile stone group.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] The additional gold and stone nodes located in the lowlands are now more evenly distributed between players.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Relic spawns have also been adjusted for balance.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Forest generation has been adjusted for balance.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Adjusted the spawn locations of distant huntable animals to provide a better balance between all players.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] The upper edges of the rocky slopes have been modified so buildings can be constructed more easily.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Additional seasons have been added for greater variety in the map.
[*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] Forage bushes have been added to improve food production on the map.
[*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] Additional lakes have frozen over in effort to balance the availability of map resources.
[*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] The distribution of gold and stone nodes has been updated for 1v1 play.
[*] [b]Bogland:[/b] “Bogland” terrain—which is unsuitable for buildings—no longer appears within each player’s immediate vicinity.
[*] [b]Golden Swamp:[/b] Four forage bushes will now spawn for each player.
[*] [b]Golden Swamp:[/b] Reduced the density of fish nodes throughout the map.
[*] [b]Golden Swamp:[/b] Re-balanced the node spawns on the central island when playing on a 3-player map.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Fixed an issue where a player could sometimes spawn too deep in the forest.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Forage Bushes should no longer grow where they block gates.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Extra gold and stone nodes have been adjusted for balance.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Player starting locations are now spaced more consistently from each other, as well as where they begin in the map.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] All huntable animals now appear consistently within the walls.
[*] [b]Hill Fort:[/b] Bases are now always surrounded by [b]Fortified Palisade Walls[/b].
[*] [b]Lombardia:[/b] Fixed a rare bug where one of the starting Town Centers could appear on the edge of the map.
[*] [b]Mediterranean:[/b] Extra sheep no longer appear when resources are set to ultra or infinite.
[*] [b]Migration:[/b] Reduced the number of cliffs spawned throughout the map.
[*] [b]Migration:[/b] Fixed a bug where the starting resource nodes would occasionally fail to spawn.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Increased the number of [b]gold nodes[/b] and [b]Ibex[/b] that spawn on the mountaintop.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Terrain unsuitable for buildings has been moved further from the starting base spawns.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Starting gold clusters have been increased to [b]6[/b] and [b]4[/b] tiles, respectively.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Starting stone clusters have been decreased from [b]4[/b] to [b]3[/b] tiles.
[*] [b]Mountain Ridge:[/b] Player gold and stone nodes spawn closer to their starting bases.
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] Players now start with a [b]Transport Ship[/b].
[*] [b]Nile Delta:[/b] The outer lands have been slightly enlarged and now spawn with mild elevation levels.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Forests have been re-balanced to not only scale with the map size, but to ensure that all players start with forests nearby.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Increased the number of starting gold clusters from [b]2[/b] to [b]3[/b]. (The third gold cluster can be found further away from the player’s base.)
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Far gold has been split into smaller clusters with [b]2[/b] tiles per group.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Reduced the total area covered by quicksand, making it easier to build on the map.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Updated nearby huntable animals to include [b]5 Zebras[/b] and [b]3 Ostriches[/b] per player.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Lakes have been adjusted to avoid spawning in players’ starting areas.
[*] [b]Serengeti:[/b] Elevation has been generally reduced to provide more tactical flexibility.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] Maps using [b]resource_delta[/b] will now accurately display HP bars over resources.
[*] Increased the limit of objects and lands that can be generated through RMS from [b]99[/b] to [b]100,000[/b].
[*] Added [b]enable_balanced_elevation[/b] command to improve hill generation in Random Map Scripts.
[*] Added [b]effect_amount[/b] to modify resource values (such a starting resources) through RMS.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]We’ve implemented various improvements to improve how matches are formed, spectated, and discovered in [i]Age of Empires II[/i]:
[list][*] If the [b]Team Together[/b] setting is enabled, [b]Team Positions[/b] will now randomly choose whether each team is placed in a clockwise or counter-clockwise direction with the rest of their team. This is done regardless of how other teams are placed on the battlefield.
[*] Players are now notified when a match is found if they are browsing the tech tree while matchmaking.
[*] Increased the spectator delay for ranked games to [b]2 minutes[/b].
[*] Lobbies that are swapped from [b]private[/b] to [b]public[/b] visibility after creation will now properly display in the lobby browser.
[*] The [b]“No games found”[/b] message no longer misinforms players when the Lobby Browser is still loading the list of available games.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]custom maps[/b] were occasionally not selectable when setting up a game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Civilization[/b] button would become unavailable after leaving a ranked match
[*] Fixed a rare issue where a game lobby would not update properly if a player entered and then left the lobby.[/list]
During [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/4310450705827484906]last week’s maintenance[/url], several fixes were implemented to improve the multiplayer experience:
[list][*] Implemented improvements to how ranked teams are formed. When searching for a match as a pre-made team, the system was inadvertently using the sum rather than the average rating of all party members. This resulted in the system creating imbalanced matches.
[*] Updated the lobby list to display more than 50 game lobbies.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=k5xT0pdOFjY;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]1v1[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Four Lakes[/b]
[*] Golden Swamp
[*] [b]Islands[/b]
[*] Hill Fort
[*] MegaRandom
[*] Nomad
[*] [b]Serengeti[/b][/list]
The [b]Team[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Black Forest[/b]
[*] Golden Swamp
[*] Hill Fort
[*] MegaRandom
[*] Nomad
[*] [b]Oasis[/b]
[*] [b]Scandinavia[/b][/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AUDIO[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a rare issue where in-game sounds would stop playing for some users after playing several consecutive matches without restarting the client.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] Units no longer stutter-step when chasing other units.
[*] Fixed an issue where lumberjacks would sometimes choose the (much longer) path less traveled when moving to chop a tree.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where large groups of units would scatter when disturbed after being idle for a long period of time.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]up-modify-group-flag InConstOn[/b] now works with values greater than [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]object-data-progress-type[/b] now returns [b]0[/b] if no action is currently being performed.
[*] Added [b]object-data-full-distance[/b], [b]object-data-tile-position[/b] and [b]object-data-tile-inverse[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]UI[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Units, buildings, and technologies that are not yet available to research or train are now displayed with a darkened icon in the command panel. ([i]This new UI feature can be enabled or disabled in the game settings[/i].)

[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/hidden_options.png[/img]

[*] Building and unit icons will now reflect their player color instead of always appearing as blue.
[*] The [b]Market[/b] sell and buy buttons will now update automatically as resource quantities change.
[*] The [b]Flaming Camel[/b] button no longer conflicts with the [b]“Go back to work”[/b] button in the Castle.
[*] Swapping between players while watching a recorded game no longer resets the map visibility setting.
[*] [b]Spectator Mode:[/b] Players are now ordered by [b]teams[/b] and then by their [b]player name[/b] in the spectator status area rather than by score. This should make it easier to track what’s happening in large team games—where score-based sorting constantly rearranges the UI.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] [b]Color Correction[/b] mods are now supported.
[*] Fixed an issue where some modded campaigns would not display their title and/or mission icons as intended.[/list]
[h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3][list][*] Making changes to the terrain/elevation of a map no longer causes performance hitches on larger maps.
[*] The [b]Change Ownership[/b] trigger now correctly resets a [b]Wonder[/b] countdown timer.[/list]

[quote][h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief overview of some of the issues that have been raised for which we are actively working on solutions:
[list][*] [b]DISCONNECTS:[/b] During the month of May, we’ll be implementing fixes for the connection issues which have been causing certain players to disconnect early on in their multiplayer matches. As always, we will be keeping a close eye on the situation following the update and will continue to collect information about any issues that arise or persist after the changes.
[*] [b]LATENCY:[/b] We’re generally seeing latency issues begin to improve, but this is another area we’ll be monitoring closely as we continue to make back-end and forward-facing improvements to the game.
[*] [b]LOCALIZATION/TRANSLATION ISSUES:[/b] We’ve been working through the reported and known translation bugs over the past several weeks, and you should begin seeing those results show up in the game now and in the coming months. These reports are a high priority for us, so keep them coming!
[*] [b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] Performance continues to be a top priority, and we’ve been working on several big improvements that we can’t wait to share with you. We hope to have something to share in the month (and months) to come.
[/list]
For other known issues, please visit [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!

[h3]:alertalert: DISCLAIMER[/h3]Please note that this list is subject to change, and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].[/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 36202
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/e7570e6888f9616efb0e74f2490f5a8853374bde.png[/img]

Happy Monday, everyone! We hope you’re staying healthy and happy, and think we have just the thing to help you part the clouds of March: [b]a new UPDATE and a new CELEBRATION to bring the best of Spring straight into your home![/b]

Along with the fixes and balance changes that accompany any game update, the team has been working on several new systems for [i]Age of Empires II[/i]. Today, you get to enjoy the many fruits ([i]3 – Food please![/i]) of their labor:
[list][*] Four brand-new [b]Art of War missions[/b] to hone your skills!
[*] Unique [b]1v1[/b] and [b]Team[/b] map pools in ranked matchmaking!
[*] Two brand new maps: [b]Four Lakes[/b] and [b]Golden Swamp[/b]!
[*] A new [b]Profile Hub[/b] now available via the main menu!
[*] The ability to view [b]ELO in unranked lobbies[/b]!
[*] Various balance changes—including a new [b]unique unit[/b] for the Tatars!
[*] The [b]SPRING CELEBRATION EVENT![/b] (Be outside while you stay inside!)
[*] [i]…and much more![/i][/list]
There are still plenty of cool features and fixes in the works for April—thanks in large part to the outstanding community members who have stepped up with their feedback and bug reports over the past few months. Your contributions play a big part in determining what to work on next; so, if you have not already, come join us on any (or all) of our official discussion channels and jump into the conversation:

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 36202 Discussion[/url][/quote]
There’s also no better time to be a part of the [i]Age of Empires II[/i] community—and this is only the beginning of our journey! The game has come a *long* way in four months, and we still have plenty of territory to explore, relics to capture, battles to win, and wonders to build as our community continues to grow. For now (and from all of us): stay safe, stay healthy, and we hope the March Update helps you enjoy your time inside.

We’ll see you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- UPDATE 36202 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]While there is plenty for you to enjoy and celebrate in today’s build, here are some of the highlights to look for in the March update:

[h3][b]Spring Celebration Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=W7igMKAmkCs;full][/previewyoutube]
As has become tradition, we’re celebrating the month and the start of the Spring season with the [b]SPRING CELEBRATION EVENT![/b] This month, we’re bringing the warmth, sunshine, and spirit of the Spring season straight to you—a much needed breath of fresh air while you’re stuck inside! Here’s what’s changing during the celebration:
[list][*] Four new [b]Profile Icons[/b].
[*] A new mod to replace player colors with a [b]saturated color palette[/b] during the event.
[*] New [b]Spring Menu[/b] background art during the event.
[*] Five [b]blooming mods[/b] to celebrate the season in style.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/SaturationView.png[/img]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/ProfileIcons-1.png[/img]
[b]Today through April 14[/b] , come back and complete daily challenges to unlock new profile icons and mods:
[list][*] [b]Sign into Xbox Live:[/b] Unlocks the Spring Woad Raider and Spring Helmet profile icon.
[*] [b]Research Hand Cart:[/b] Unlocks the ‘lush town center mod’ and the Spring Villager profile icon.
[*] [b]Build a Trade Cart:[/b] Unlocks ‘pink petal berry bushes mod’ and Spring Teuton Knight profile icon.
[*] [b]Build at least 5 farms in a single game:[/b] Unlocks the ‘lush terrain’ mod.
[*] [b]Gather at least 2020 food in a single game:[/b] Unlocks the ‘floral explosions’ (for Petards and Demo Ships) mod.
[*] [b]Reach at least 100 population:[/b] Unlocks the ‘arrows replaced by flowers’ mod.[/list]
[b]As a bonus,[/b] we’re also making the [b]PHOTON MAN[/b] challenge available as a bonus task for those who missed it during our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/partnerevents/view/1699483658360122574]Anniversary Event[/url]. This time, you can unlock it even if you own one game on the Windows Store and the other on Steam; simply log into your Xbox Live account in both games and complete the achievement to enjoy the classic cheat unit in [i]Age of Empires II[/i]:
[list][*] [b]Earn the “21st Century” Achievement in Age of Empires: Definitive Edition:[/b] Unlocks the Photon-Man cheat code, permanently![/list]
[b]And as a double-super-bonus:[/b] log in with your [b]Xbox Live[/b] account during the event to keep *ALL* the mods and Profile icons you unlock… [i]FOR-EV-ER![/i] Pretty great, right? We hope you enjoy the Spring Celebration Event, and look forward to seeing you on the [strike]battle[/strike] flower fields!

[h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=BRjWBi78Zwg;full][/previewyoutube]
The [b]Art of War[/b] missions are short challenges designed to help players who are looking to learn the base mechanics of [i]Age of Empires II[/i].  The original five challenges helped lay the groundwork of your civilization: teaching you how to build an economy, grow your civilization rapidly, raise an army, defend against aggression from your opponents, and quickly progress through the Ages.

Today, four brand-new missions have been added as we continue to build on the knowledge that will help you prevail in [i]Age of Empires[/i]:
[list][*] [b]Land Battle:[/b] Learn about unit counters and basic maneuvers on the battlefield.
[*] [b]Destroying a Castle:[/b] Learn about early siege attacks against fortified positions.
[*] [b]Naval Battle:[/b] Learn about water combat and how to prevail on the high seas.
[*] [b]Battle Formations[/b]: Learn when and how to use formations to keep your troops alive and outmaneuver the enemy[/list]
Give them a try, and then keep practicing until you can achieve a Gold medal in each challenge; this will ensure that you have the fundamentals you need to succeed on the live battlefield!

[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where discovering the [b]Bombard Cannons[/b] on [b]Genghis Khan - Mission 3[/b] ("Into China") would crash the client.
[*] Fixed a variety of one-off crashes.
[*] Fixed various issues when transferring restored game files.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]PERFORMANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Reduced the file size of assets by 1GB, and by an additional 1GB for players running the Enhanced Graphics Pack DLC.
[*] Continued improvements to how VRAM and RAM is utilized when running the game.
[*] Implemented various performance improvements.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Auto-Scout is now available for all [b]horse[/b] and [b]camel[/b] variants of the initial Scout unit.
[*] Fixed an issue where right-clicking to attack a specific enemy in a mixed army could result in insubordination by the ordered units.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where units tasked to [b]attack ground[/b] would sometimes ignore the command and attack the closest enemy unit instead.
[*] Fixed an issue where defensive structures would sometimes stop attacking targets.
[*] Packed [b]Trebuchets[/b] which auto-pack and then chase another Trebuchet (target) can no longer instantly destroy the enemy Trebuchet without unpacking.
[*] Selecting more than one control group using [b]Shift[/b] no longer merges them into one group by default. A new [b]Shift Group Appending[/b] option has been added to enable or disable this behavior.
[*] [b]Attack ground[/b] is no longer available for [b]Trebuchets[/b] when playing [b]Treaty[/b].
[*] Fixed a rare issue where [b]Siege Towers[/b] could be used to move units across terrain obstructions such as cliffs.
[*] [b]Furor Celtica[/b] now applies to [b]Rams[/b] and [b]Siege Towers[/b] which have units garrisoned inside.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Steppe Lancer [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Increased the base attack of both the standard and elite unit by [b]+1[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Chinese[/b][/h3][list][*] No longer have access to the [b]Redemption[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]Cumans[/b][/h3][list][*] No longer have access to the Redemption technology.
[*] Can now research the [b]Capped Ram[/b] upgrade in the Castle Age as a civilization bonus.
[*] [b]Kipchak [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Now fire [b]+1[/b] extra arrow.
[*] [b]Steppe Husbandry:[/b] Now grants its benefits to [b]Steppe Lancers[/b].
[*] [b]Steppe Husbandry:[/b] Now reduces the training time of Scout Cavalry, Cavalry Archers, and Steppe Lancers by [b]50%[/b] (was [b]80%[/b]).[/list]
[h3][b]Goths[/b][/h3][list][*] No longer have access to the [b]Arson[/b] technology.
[*] The civilization bonus affecting the cost of infantry units has now been staggered per Age: [b]20%[/b] cheaper (Dark Age) →  [b]25%[/b] cheaper (Feudal Age) →  [b]30%[/b] cheaper (Castle Age) →  [b]35%[/b] cheaper (Imperial Age)
[*] The civilization bonus boosting [b]infantry attack vs. buildings[/b] now increments by [b]+1 attack per Age[/b] (starting in the Feudal Age).[/list]
[h3][b]Tatars[/b][/h3][list][*] Now gain the [b]Thumb Ring[/b] technology for free as a civilization bonus.
[*] [b]Keshik:[/b] Reduced the training time from [b]23[/b] to [b]16 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elite Keshik:[/b] Reduced the training time from [b]20[/b] to [b]14 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Silk Armor:[/b] Now grants its benefits to [b]Steppe Lancers[/b].
[*] [b]Timurid Siegecraft:[/b] Increased the bonus range granted to [b]Trebuchets[/b] from [b]+1[/b] to [b]+2[/b].
[*] [b]Timurid Siegecraft:[/b] Now makes the new [b]Flaming Camel[/b] unit available when researched—a fast-moving Petard with bonuses vs. mounted units and elephants.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGNS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Art-of-War-March-Update.png[/img]

Four brand-new missions have been added to the [b]Art of War[/b] tutorials:
[list][*] [b]Land Battle:[/b] Learn about unit counters and basic maneuvers!
[*] [b]Battle Formations:[/b] Learn when and how to use formations effectively!
[*] [b]Naval Battle:[/b] Learn about amphibious combat and how to prevail on the high seas!
[*] [b]Destroying a Castle:[/b] Learn about early siege attacks against fortified positions![/list]
In addition to these new missions, we’ve implemented the following:
[list][*] Added localized versions of the [b]Art of War[/b] introduction videos for all supported audio languages.
[*] [b]Booming:[/b] Players can now properly advance to the Imperial Age after building two Castle Age buildings, rather than having to build a Castle.
[*] [b]Booming:[/b] Fixed a separate issue where players could advance to the Imperial Age [i]without[/i] constructing the prerequisite buildings.
[*] [b]Rushing the Enemy:[/b] The kill counter will now increment properly as soon as you start killing enemy villagers.[/list]
[h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed various instances where the dialogue text and voiceover audio did not agree during the [b]Dracula[/b] campaign.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Predators will no longer spawn on top of Relics.[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] Updated the map to ensure a more consistent and fair distribution of resources: including hills, forests, and lakes.
[*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] Each player will now start with [b]one close lake[/b] and [b]two small forests[/b]. Each close lake contains four deep fish within the reach of shore fishermen.
[*] [b]Alpine Lakes:[/b] In addition to fish and herdables, players now start with an [b]extra boar[/b].
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Reduced the number and length of cliffs that spawn on the map, allowing for more open gameplay.
[*] [b]Arabia:[/b] Extra gold and stone deposits have been adjusted to distribute more evenly amongst the players.
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] Deer now always appear within the bounds of the player walls.
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] Fixed a bug where, on occasion, only four Relics would appear on a tiny map (instead of five).
[*] [b]Arena:[/b] Adjusted the number of [b]Relics[/b] spawned to match other maps. Six-player maps will now spawn [b]7[/b] Relics, and eight-player maps will spawn [b]8[/b] Relics.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Extra gold and stone deposits have been adjusted to distribute more evenly amongst the players.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Adjusted the distance of stone and gold deposits to prevent them from blocking gates.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Altered the way the map is generated to prevent player bases from overlapping.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Guaranteed that one pile of stone now always appears within the walls of each player’s base.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Boars will now consistently spawn inside of the player’s base.
[*] [b]Hideout:[/b] Groups of Deer will now either appear entirely within the walls (50% of the time) or well outside of them.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Added new map variations to make better use of the [b]Mangrove Shallows/Forests[/b] terrain.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Adjusted the balance of deer spawns to ensure an average of [b]4[/b] deer per player.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Fixed several bugs that caused issues with the generation of gold and stone.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Increased the amount of starting gold spawned on the [b]Empire Wars[/b] game mode.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Added a tooltip to game lobbies that provides a detailed look at any player’s stats: including their [b]rating, rank, wins, losses,[/b] and [b]win percentage[/b].[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/d0abccd7-e5f1-4df3-8295-a2869b1cf2d8.png[/img]
[list][*] The [b]Technology Tree[/b] can now be viewed while in the matchmaking queue. ([i]And there was much rejoicing…![/i])
[*] The number of [b]spectators[/b] and [b]Game ID[/b] are now displayed while spectating a match.
[*] Added the ability to pick your [b]player color[/b] in ranked matchmaking. This now also controls your starting team position based on the selected color.
[*] Teams in ranked matchmaking now delegate their map bans to the party leader.
[*] Updated the default team selection from [b]“-“[/b] to [b]“?”[/b] in multiplayer lobbies.
[*] [b]Team Positions[/b] can no longer be selected when playing custom scenarios.
[*] Two new maps inspired by the community—[b]Four Lakes[/b] and [b]Golden Swamp[/b]—are now available in the Random Map selection screen by default.
[*] Fixed an issue where custom scenario lobbies would incorrectly display the previously-selected Random Map as the location.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would run slower for players than for spectators.
[*] Implemented additional tracking and safeguards to defend against cheat programs.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/h3][list][*] The ranked map pool is now unique depending on whether you’re playing [b]1v1[/b] or as a [b]Team[/b]. Nine total maps are still available in both modes: six that are playable in both, and three [b]exclusive maps[/b] that only appear in the 1v1 or Team queue.[/list]
The [b]1v1[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] [b]Acropolis[/b]
[*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Four Lakes[/b]
[*] [b]Mediterranean[/b]
[*] MegaRandom
[*] Golden Swamp
[*] Hideout
[*] Nomad[/list]
The [b]Team[/b] map pool is as follows:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] [b]Black Forest[/b]
[*] [b]Lombardia[/b]
[*] MegaRandom
[*] Golden Swamp
[*] Hideout
[*] Nomad
[*] [b]Team Islands[/b][/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GRAPHICS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The [b]Slavs, Magyars, Lithuanians[/b], and [b]Bulgarians[/b] now have a unique set of sails for their ships.
[*] [b]Vietnamese Transport Ships[/b] now use the correct set of sails.
[*] [b]Sea Gates[/b] now have destruction animations.
[*] [b]Imperial Camels[/b] no longer wield their shields upside down when walking.
[*] Terrain grid lines are now less intrusive.
[*] Updated the visual look of [b]Relics[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AUDIO[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Indian Villagers no longer say [i]♪ “attack” ♪[/i] when tasked to move.
[*] Properly limited how gunpower sounds are played when too many of them are triggered at the same time.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Improved the effectiveness of AI players on the [b]Hamburger[/b] map.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI-controlled players would continue to send unit commands after resigning or being defeated.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI-controlled players would play too passively before reaching the Imperial Age.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI would occasionally resign too early in team games.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI players would send tribute to the host player rather than the player that requested the resources.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI-controlled players would build excessive numbers of military buildings.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where explorer units would occasionally fall idle.[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue where units would be paralyzed with fear instead of properly fleeing enemy aggressors.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Bombard Cannons[/b] would fail to interrupt their attack-move under certain circumstances.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where a trapped scout using auto-scout could cause the game to lag.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] Siege weapons are no longer affected by [b]sn-task-ungrouped-soldiers[/b].
[*] [b]unit-type-count-total[/b] now counts additional objects in the unit queue.
[*] [b]up-pending-objects[/b] now counts additional objects in the unit queue.
[*] [b]up-garrison[/b] now accepts unit lines.
[*] [b]up-modify-group-flag[/b] can now be used to select and see which units are in what group.
[*] [b]up-find-remote[/b] can now find building foundations.
[*] [b]sn-allow-civilian-defense[/b] set to 0 and [b]sn-allow-civilian-offense[/b] set to ≥1 will no longer make villagers retreat.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]UI[/b] ◆[/h1][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/7d78a9ca-b791-46fb-9124-57c4158fa9e7-1.png[/img]
[list][*] Added a new [b]Player Profile[/b] hub where you can view your game stats and collections. This is accessible directly from the main menu!
[*] Fixed a rare issue where chat messages were sometimes not sent to everyone.
[*] [b]Shift-clicking[/b] a stack of units in the building queue now decreases the queued total by [b]5[/b].
[*] All herdable [b]cows[/b] will now show the correct message in the UI when found.
[*] The minimap now updates correctly when switching between players using hotkeys while watching a recorded game.
[*] The [b]Map Seed[/b] is now visible in the objectives panel for spectated and recorded games. This information is useful when reporting issues with a randomly generated map.
[*] The game no longer inserts a [b]“/”[/b] in front of non-taunt numbers when the [b]/Taunts[/b] option is turned off.
[*] The [b]Chieftains[/b] technology no longer displays an incorrect description in the notification area when researched.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Palette[/b] mods are now possible.
[*] It is now possible to use OPUS encoded WEM files in audio mods.[/list]
[h3][b]Scenario Editor[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Play Sound[/b] trigger effect now works with custom sounds.
[*] Added a unique model for the [b]Heavy Swordsman[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue where some random maps did not appear in the Scenario Editor’s “random map list.”[/list]

[h1][b]--------------------------------------------[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track issues reported by the community for future updates. Here is a brief overview of some of the issues that have been raised for which we are actively working on solutions:
[list][*] [b]LATENCY & DISCONNECTS:[/b] The connectivity and stability of the game are still our top priority. While we continue to implement advancements and prevention measures with each new build, we’re always on the lookout for issues that impact your ability to play. We are continuing to keep a close eye on the reports of input latency, server issues, and disconnects, and will continue doing everything we can to get these resolved for as many people as possible.
[*] [b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] Speed is everything in [i]AoE2:DE[/i], and we want to ensure that the game makes the most of your hardware setup. We are continuing to make gains wherever possible, and will continue to work on raising the bar month after month.
[*] [b]TEXT FILTERING:[/b] We’ve heard your cries and seen the ***** **** ** ******; and the team is investigating solutions that not only (more accurately) reflect the communication style of the community, but give us more control over where we set the bar both now and into the future. Watch for more updates to come!
[*] [b]LOCALIZATION/TRANSLATION ISSUES:[/b] The community has done a [i]fantastic[/i] job compiling lists of areas in the game where the translation is incorrect, missing, or could use improvement. We are watching for your reports on our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]official forum[/url] and will continue to implement solutions as they come our way! Keep it up!
[*] [b]GAME BALANCE (incl. AUTO-SCOUTING):[/b] With the rich variety of civilizations in the game, there will always be room for adjustments to the balance of power. This also goes for new features—such as auto-scouting—where we will continue to see what can be done to strike a balance between accessibility for new players and mastery by veterans in the game.
[/list]
For other known issues, please visit [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]this page[/url] to see what’s being tracked!

[quote][h3]DISCLAIMER[/h3]Please note that this list is subject to change, and should not be considered a comprehensive list of all the known issues we’re tracking. The above is to inform you of the team’s current priorities, which will change as other issues arise or take precedence.

For the latest updates and announcements, please visit our [url=https://twitter.com/ageofempires]social channels[/url].[/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 35584
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/07c513418e4c1d2f67dd18bdda17875eca31dbea.png[/img]

Welcome, one and all, to the massive [b]FEBRUARY UPDATE[/b] for [i]Age of Empires II![/i] It may be a short month, but we’ve taken advantage of every day to put together a package of changes and improvements to the game!

As has become standard with our major monthly updates, the team has supplied a huge list of changes for you to read up on and integrate into your daily play. This includes:
[list][*] New feature: [b]Auto Scouting![/b]
[*] A new [b]Anniversary Event[/b] to unlock exclusive goodies for the game!
[*] Ongoing [b]performance improvements and crash fixes[/b] for new and outstanding issues!
[*] Is that the [b]Vietnamese[/b] civilization in the Civilization Balance section?!
[*] Much-requested improvements to the [b]AI, pathfinding,[/b] and other areas of the game!
[*] [i]…and so much more![/i][/list]
We’ve tried to address the biggest points of feedback provided by our players over the past month, and encourage you to [b]continue making your voice heard[/b] as issues arise or ideas emerge to improve the game. Here’s a few of the places where we’re tuned-in:

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 35584 Discussion[/url][/quote]
Let us know what you think about this month’s update; enjoy the festival and the extra day of [i]Age of Empires[/i] in your February!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- UPDATE 35584 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]Today’s update comes with a bunch of exciting new features and spotlights outside of the balance changes and fixes for the game:
[h3][b]Auto-Scouting[/b][/h3][previewyoutube=fnwU27bcGxc;full][/previewyoutube]
In this update, you’ll find a new feature available for your starting Scout: Auto Scouting!

When you enable ‘Auto Scouting’ from the unit’s command interface, it will automatically send the Scout on the same scouting pattern used by the AI. You can easily take control back by disabling auto-scout or issuing a manual command, which will take priority over the automatic behavior.

[list][*] ‘Auto Scout’ is only available for your starting Scout unit(s), not for trained Scouts.
[list][*] Note that auto-scout [i]does not[/i] currently affect all horse types (as intended); this will be fixed in a future update.
[*] Note that auto-scout [i]does not[/i] apply to other starting units spawned by the MegaRandom map.[/list]
[*] Works in every part of the game: [b]Single Player[/b] and [b]Multiplayer[/b] matches, as well as the [b]Campaign[/b] missions.
[*] Issuing a manual command will seed control of the unit back to the player and disable auto-scouting.[/list]
Naturally, manual scouting will still be a lot more intuitive and accurate when it comes to understanding your opponent’s strategy and the map layout early on; but for players new to the game, this is designed to ease the early-game learning curve.

[h3][b]Age of Empires Anniversary Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=XLYLHU_zDGM;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re celebrating the second anniversary of [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i] this month, which means it’s time to don your best Stone Age garb for the [b]AGE OF EMPIRES: DE ANNIVERSARY EVENT![/b]

Starting [b]NOW through March 12[/b], you can unlock and complete daily challenges to earn exclusive goodies to infuse some of that *classic* [i]Age of Empires[/i] charm into [i]Age of Empires II.[/i] Here’s are some of the things you can unlock over the next few weeks:
[list][*] New Profile Icons! (Seen Below)
[*] Unique unit skins: including the classic Scout, Legion, and Priest!
[*] Introducing a new Cheat Code to bring the PHOTON MAN to [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]
[*] The classic [i]♪ wololo ♪[/i] chant for your Monks![/list]
Any challenges you complete must be done before [b]March 12th[/b], when the event concludes! While any profile Icons and cheats you unlock are yours to keep, the mods will disappear along with the event—so enjoy them while the celebration lasts!

More information about the event can be [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/news/aoede-anniversary-event/]found here[/url].

[h3][b]Player Reporting & Safety[/b][/h3]Today’s build also includes a necessary safety tool for our community: [b]Player Reporting![/b]

As we continue to support and grow the [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] community, there will inevitably come those who strive only to disrupt others’ ability to play and enjoy the game. While many of the most egregious cases are detected and blocked by the Xbox Live and Steam platforms, it’s up to the community to help maintain a safe and healthy space where automation cannot account for human “creativity.”

The new [b]Report[/b] button allows you to report conduct violations that fall in the following categories:
[list][*] Cheating
[*] Griefing
[*] Inactivity (AFK)
[*] Inappropriate Lobby Name
[*] Inappropriate Player Name
[*] Offensive Clan Name
[*] Offensive Clan Tag
[*] Offensive Clan Description
[*] Verbal Abuse
[*] Other[/list]
You will also be asked to provide a note whenever you submit a report, so be sure to include any details you can about the given incident; the more more information you provide, the easier it is for our Support team to decide what action to take.

[b]Account Actions[/b]
