If and when action is taken against an account, a message is displayed on the game home screen describing the duration of the given punishment. There are a few actions Support may take based on the severity or frequency of the abuse:
[list][*] Chat Mute
[*] Temporary Multiplayer Suspension
[*] Multiplayer Ban[/list]
Actions will be taken based on the Microsoft, Xbox and [i]Age of Empires[/i] Code of Conduct, so be sure to review our policies if you have any questions about what is considered acceptable (and unacceptable) behavior:
[list][*] [url=https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement/]Microsoft Services Agreement[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/intellectualproperty/copyright/default.aspx]Microsoft Terms of Use[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.xbox.com/Legal/XboxComTOU]Xbox Terms of Use[/url][/list]
[b]Profanity Filter[/b]
As many players have noted, a new [b]profanity filter[/b] was implemented in the last hotfix to help protect against disruptive and toxic language in the game. This is a system that we are actively monitoring, tweaking, and planning for additional adjustments in the future.

[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an uncommon issue where leaving a game lobby and creating a new one would cause it to load indefinitely.
[*] Fixed a crash when clicking the [b]Browse Mods[/b] tab.
[*] Fixed a crash when using hotkeys to quickly jump between multiple units or buildings.
[*] Fixed a crash triggered by a player exiting the game during the countdown timer for a 1v1 matchup.
[*] Fixed a crash caused when opening the [b]Benchmark Test[/b] while running a data mod.
[*] Fixed a circumstantial crash triggered when loading or shortly after loading a restored game.
[*] Fixed a rare crash that could be triggered by opening the in-game chat menu.
[*] Fixed various crashes that could occur when launching the game.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]PERFORMANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Implemented several potential fixes to address disconnects within the first few minutes of a multiplayer match.
[*] Improved the way RAM is allocated on low-end machines in order to improve performance and mitigate crashes related to running out of memory.
[*] Improved the overall performance of the game when running the [b]Enhanced Graphics Pack (UHD)[/b] DLC.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]Mangonels[/b] would “slide” in combat—allowing them to fire in directions they were not visually facing.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Trebuchets[/b] would not move to attack their out-of-range targets when using the old waypoint system.
[*] [b]Villagers[/b] will no longer drop resources as soon as they are reassigned to collect a new  resource. Instead, they will maintain any collected resources until they begin the new task. The collected resources can now be instantly dropped by reassigning to a new resource with [b]CTRL + Right Click[/b].
[*] [b]Villagers[/b] tasked to gather food from a boar will now do so consistently instead of pondering the meaning of their existence.
[*] Fixed an issue where a boar’s path could not be blocked once aggroed.
[*] Fixed an issue where units would occasionally ignore waypoint commands.
[*] Researching the [b]Spies[/b] technology will no longer cause buildings to appear in the fog of war after they’ve been destroyed.
[*] When multiple buildings are selected, technologies will now prioritize buildings that are idle or have no building queue over stacking up in a single building.
[*] Defensive structures will now prioritize attacking enemy units over buildings unless manually tasked to do so.
[*] In rare circumstances, units can no longer be trained in the incorrect structure by rapidly swapping between two buildings.
[*] Trebuchets will now remain unpacked when a Villager is ordered to provide repairs while in the same selection group as said Trebuchet.
[*] [b]Multi-queue[/b] now works when the foundation of an unfinished [b]Town Center[/b] is selected along with completed Town Centers.
[*] Clicking [b]Save Chapter[/b] will no longer inspire idle villagers to seek out tasks after saving the game.
[*] The [b]CTRL + SHIFT + [F1-F9][/b] hotkey can now be used in single player games to swap between the different player views. Note that using this will count as cheat, thus preventing achievement progression in the match it is used.
[*] Adjusted how gate rotation functions to avoid conflicting with other hotkey prioritizations.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]Berbers[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Genitour:[/b] Now receive [b]+1[/b] pierce armor.[/list]
[h3][b]Goths[/b][/h3][list][*] Infantry are now 35% cheaper in all Ages. This bonus previously applied following the [b]Feudal Age.[/b][/list]
[h3][b]Khmer[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Khmer’s[/b] unique farming bonus is now disabled in [b]Full Tech Tree[/b] games.[/list]
[h3][b]Mongols[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Hunters:[/b] Reduced their work speed from [b]50%[/b] to [b]40%[/b].
[*] Now have access to the [b]Steppe Lancer[/b] and [b]Elite Steppe Lancer[/b] units.
[*] All [b]Steppe Lancers[/b] also benefit from the [b]+30% HP[/b] bonus enjoyed by Mongol horsemen.[/list]
[h3][b]Persians[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the cost of researching the [b]Kamandaran[/b] technology from [b]200 food, 200 gold[/b] to [b]400 food, 300 gold[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Portuguese[/b][/h3][list][*] Feitoria: Increased the resources generated per second from [b]0.8 food, 0.8 wood, 0.45 gold, 0.25 stone[/b] to [b]1.6 food, 1.0 wood, 0.7 gold, 0.3 stone[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Tatars[/b][/h3][list][*] Now have access to the [b]Halberdier[/b] unit.[/list]
[h3][b]Teutons[/b][/h3][list][*] As a civilization bonus, [b]Farms[/b] are now [b]40%[/b] cheaper (was [b]33%[/b]).
[*] Starting in the [b]Castle Age[/b], Barracks units gain [b]+1 armor[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Vietnamese[/b][/h3][list][*] Economic upgrades no longer cost wood.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGNS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Selecting a custom Campaign will now load its missions without requiring the player to select the campaign a second time.[/list]
[h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed a rare issue where loading an [b]Art of War[/b] mission save could result in a permanent black fog settling in over the main menu screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where swapping text languages would displace the [b]Art of War[/b] mission medals.[/list]
[h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Dracula 2: ‘The Return of the Dragon’:[/b] Units garrisoned in “captured” Castles and Docks can now be ungarrisoned from the building.
[*] [b]Gajah Mada 3: ‘The Oath to Nullify Nusantara’:[/b] Fixed an issue where completing the scenario objectives would not trigger the completion of the mission.
[*] [b]Sforza 4: ‘Blood and Betrayal’:[/b] Text will no longer overlap the images during the opening slideshow.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] [b]Sushi Lover:[/b] Can now be [properly] unlocked by training 30 Japanese fishing ships.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, AI players would immediately kill off their villagers on [b]Earth[/b] and [b]Nile Delta[/b] maps.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented monuments from generating resources on [b]Island[/b] maps.[/list]
[h3][b]Map Settings[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Show Suggested Maps[/b] option will now remain toggled to your choice when you exit and re-enter the map selection screen.
[*] [b]Capture the Relic:[/b] The game will no longer spawn a second [b]Monastery[/b] if the map has already spawned one for a player.
[*] [b]Capture the Relic:[/b] Fixed an issue where [b]Monasteries[/b] could spawn into the map with a “more on-fire than intended” amount of health.
[*] [b]Regicide:[/b] Will now properly adjust resource numbers based on whether the host chooses [b]Low, Standard, or High resources[/b]. (Infinite is still infinite.)[/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3]As one of the most popular maps when playing the Regicide game mode, we wanted to add some extra flavor to the [b]Fortress[/b] map; this shouldn’t shake things up too much, but we welcome any feedback if it turns out to be disruptive:
[list][*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Players now begin with a [b]Castle[/b] regardless of game mode. (Originally, Castles would only spawn when playing Regicide.)[/list]
Several changes have been made to the [b]Gold Rush[/b] map in order to create a more open and aggressive battlefield:
[list][*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Forests are now split into smaller patches and player bases are now situated in a clearing. Note that the overall amount of wood on the map remains the same.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Removed cliffs from the map.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Predators have been spread out more evenly across the map.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Lake generation has been adjusted so lakes are smaller and do not appear too close to players.
[*] [b]Gold Rush:[/b] Extra stone and gold nodes have been adjusted to be more accessible to players.[/list]
Other map changes:
[list][*] [b]Lombardia:[/b] Reverted the number of [b]Relics[/b] that spawn on the map to their original totals: [b]5[/b] will spawn as a baseline, [b]7[/b] with six players, and [b]8[/b] with eight players.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Adjusted how the map is generated to prevent the creation of vulnerable trade routes or thin strips of land between players. Player islands now have a consistent shape with moderate variation around the edges.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Players will now spawn a consistent distance from the edges: [b]7[/b] tiles on smaller map sizes and [b]9[/b] tiles on larger map sizes.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] On Medium (2v2) maps, [b]Relics[/b] have been assigned per player to prevent them from stacking in favor of one player or team.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Removed extra deer and boar spawns.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Fixed an issue with terrain generation during the Mediterranean season.
[*] [b]Valley:[/b] Zebras will now spawn in the middle of the valley (as intended) during the African season.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]assign_to command[/b] has been added. This can be used to assign a land to a player, color, or team in combination with [b]direct_placement[/b].
[*] The [b]Random Map[/b] game mode can now be detected using [b]RANDOM_MAP[/b] identifier.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Locked down settings which could still be altered after a lobby host readied up for the match.
[*] Match options that are hidden from the host (based on the game mode) will now properly hide from other players in the lobby.
[*] Players will now be prompted to subscribe to a data mod as soon as they join a lobby to prevent a crash triggered when downloading the mod.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player color, civilization choice, team selection, and ready status of other players would not update for new players joining a lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Blind Random[/b] setting would always default to and load the [b]Coastal[/b] map.
[*] Fixed an issue where lobby settings and custom map pools would not be saved when creating a new lobby.
[*] Fixed an issue where UI elements from previous game lobbies would persist into future game lobbies.
[*] Fixed an issue where setting a lobby slot to “Open” would close the slot and setting it to “Closed” would open it.
[*] Fixed an issue where the lobby browser would search for games indefinitely rather than timing out when no games were available.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the [b]Spectator Delay[/b] setting could not be changed until the server location was changed.
[*] Queuing for an auto-match will no longer enable [b]Team Positions[/b] in team games.
[*] Added contextual hints to the [b]Banned Map[/b] screen to explain each map. Tooltips will need to be enabled to display the information.
[*] Added the ability to run a [b]Ranked Benchmark Test[/b] from the Ranked lobby screen.[/list]
[h3][b]Ranked Map Rotation[/b][/h3]We’ve updated this month’s map pool for everyone diving into the ranked arena:
[list][*] Alpine Lakes
[*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] Black Forest
[*] Golden Pit
[*] Hideout
[*] Mediterranean
[*] MegaRandom
[*] Nomad[/list]
As there are now [b]nine[/b] total maps in the ranked rotation, we’ve also increased the number of map bans available to players:
[list][*] 1v1: 4 bans (was 3)
[*] 2v2: 2 bans (was 1)
[*] 3v3: 1 ban
[*] 4v4: 1 ban (was 0)[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GRAPHICS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Implemented various bug fixes and updates to art assets.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where unit outlines would display behind buildings, but in the incorrect color.
[*] Units hiding behind Siege Towers will now display outlines.
[*] Fixed an issue where unit footprints and dust effects would appear on top of units.
[*] Fixed an issue where zooming in and out or scrolling around the map would cause buildings, units, and resources to visually vibrate.
[*] Fixed an uncommon issue where units would “flicker” when not using the Enhanced Graphics Pack DLC.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AUDIO[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Using [b]SHIFT + period (.)[/b] and [b]SHIFT + comma (,)[/b] now plays the selection sounds for the unit or building selected, or plays the [i]♪ action failed ♪[/i] sound if no unit is found.
[*] The [i][b]♪ Under Attack ♪[/b][/i] and [i][b]♪ Under Monk Attack ♪[/b][/i] sounds have been redesigned based on community feedback.
[*] Unique [i]♪ buy ♪[/i] and [i]♪ sell ♪[/i] sounds will now play when trading goods in the [b]Market[/b].
[*] Updated the sound effects for the [b]Harbor[/b] and [b]Longboat[/b].
[*] Increased the volume of the [b]Siege Ram’s[/b] attack sounds.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Cavalry[/b] and [b]Camelry[/b] did not include their rider death sounds when killed.
[*] Wild [b]Horses[/b] and [b]Camels[/b] now have death sounds.
[*] Adjusted the attack sound delays for [b]Conquistadors[/b] and several other ranged units.
[*] Corrected several instances where ranged units were not using the correct attack sound.
[*] The sounds of arrows being shot from buildings are now more succinct.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Implemented improvements to prevent AI players from locking up and failing to issue any new commands during a match.
[*] AI-controlled [b]Eagle Scouts[/b] now use the improved scouting behaviors employed by normal [b]Scouts[/b].
[*] Fixed an uncommon issue where AI-controlled [b]Scouts[/b] would, in certain circumstances, act erratically.
[*] Fixed an issue where allied AI players would constantly beg for resources during multiplayer games.
[*] Tempered the desire of computer-controlled players to kite and use hit-and-run tactics on lower difficulty levels. On higher difficulties, the computer will attempt to strike a balance between moving and attacking their enemy.
[*] Made several general improvements to the strategic decision-making capabilities of AI-controlled players, such as the unit choices they make throughout the course of a match.
[*] Improved the strategies an AI-controlled player will utilize throughout a match based on their civilization’s strengths, the map type, and enemy army compositions.
[*] Implemented improvements to the early-game economy of AI-controlled players.
[*] AI-controlled players will now use their villagers to counter attackers in more situations, such as when attacked using Rams, by single military units, or in situations where their own military units are unavailable to help.
[*] AI players will now respond to repeated aggression on their villagers rather than ignoring the continued threat from an enemy player.
[*] Improved the responsiveness of AI-controlled players to commands from human allies.
[*] AI-controlled players will now include gates in walls they build as a result of [b]Taunt 54[/b] (‘Build a wall between the two flared locations’).
[*] [b]Extreme AI:[/b] Improved the tactical awareness of AI-controlled players in a variety of situations. AI players will now retreat from hopeless fights before they suffer significant losses, and will prioritize enemy targets with monks, military, and siege units more effectively.
[*] [b]Extreme AI:[/b] Improved the AI’s ability to secure their villagers before they’ve suffered too many casualties as a result of an enemy raid.
[*] [b]Extreme AI:[/b] AI-controlled trade units will no longer choose dangerous trade routes when safer options are available.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI-controlled players would not build [b]Transport Ships[/b] on the [b]Hamburger[/b] map.
[*] Improved the behavior of AI-controlled players on the [b]Yin Yang[/b] special map.[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] Continued to implement improvements to guard against units passing through solid buildings, resource nodes, and other normally impassable objects.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI units set to attack-move would ignore the order after attacking and killing an enemy unit along their path.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]object-data-formation-id[/b] and [b]object-data-garrison-id[/b] now return the correct values.
[*] [b]dropsite-min-distance[/b] and [b]sn-enable-boar-hunting[/b] now account for ostriches, zebras, and ibexes.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]UI[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] The [b]Krepost[/b] now properly denotes that it increases the population cap when constructed.
[*] Added an in-game error message when the servers are down for maintenance. [i](Please note that this does not yet include in-game messaging when counting down to a planned service outage.)[/i]
[*] The [b]History[/b] screen now lists civilizations by their localized name rather than the order dictated by their English names.
[*] Attempting to save a game using the same file name as another saved game will now prompt you to overwrite the old file. Previously, the save prompt would close without saving the game.
[*] Added a [b]‘Copy’[/b] button to the multiplayer lobby to copy the Game ID to your clipboard for easy sharing.
[*] The Game ID of the current lobby is now displayed to all players joining a lobby including the host.
[*] The [b]Wonder countdown[/b] will now disappear as soon as the Wonder is destroyed rather than waiting for the Wonder’s destruction animation to complete.
[*] Added a hotkey to train the ten free [b]Elite Kipchak[/b] unlocked when a player researches the [b]Cuman Mercenaries[/b] technology.
[*] The total number of completed games are now tallied properly in the multiplayer [b]Profile[/b].
[*] Researched unit and technologies will now display properly in the in-game technology tree.
[*] Fixed a bug where a [b]Farm’s[/b] foundation outline would not display when the [b]Terrain Grid Display[/b] setting was disabled.
[*] Fixed a scaling issue with the terrain grid when zooming in and out.
[*] Fixed an issue where the loading screen would fail to hide itself after loading into a match.
[*] Fixed an issue where losing population-supporting buildings and then losing units would stop the population counter from flashing to inform you that additional units cannot be produced.
[*] Fixed a rare bug where discarding changes in any [b]Settings[/b] menu could cause issues when navigating the [b]Hotkeys[/b] menu.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented tool-tips from appearing on the statistics screen.[/list]
[quote]Please note that some hotkeys will be reset to their default settings due to some of the changes listed above. The hotkey groups affected are the [b]zoom[/b] and [b]gate[/b] commands, as well as the [b]ungarrison[/b] hotkey.[/quote]
[h3][b]Localization[/b][/h3][list][*] Implemented several new localization strings where they were previously missing.
[*] Fixed an issue where changing the font to [b]Sans Serif[/b] while using the [b]Turkish[/b] language would prevent certain characters from appearing.
[*] [b]BR:[/b] Fixed an issue where the ‘Ranked Benchmark Test” (Teste de Benchmark com Classificacao) text would extend beyond the borders of the button when using [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b] text.
[*] [b]DE:[/b] Fixed an issue where “UGC” (Nutzer-Inhalte) and “Location” (Karte) would overlap in the Lobby Browser and Spectate Game tabs when using [b]German[/b] text.
[*] [b]DE:[/b] Fixed an issue where “View Pending Request” text (“Ausstehende Anfragen anzeigen”) would overrun the UI bounds when using [b]German[/b] text.
[*] [b]FR:[/b] Fixed audio lines not playing in the correct order in the [b]Dracula 3[/b] mission.
[*] [b]MAL:[/b] Fixed text spacing on the first slide of the [b]Tamerlane 1[/b] mission.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue that prevented the modification of civilization theme music.
[*] The priority of mods can now be adjusted without having to relaunch the game client.
[*] Players will now receive a warning that prompts them to select one of the available civilizations if certain civilizations are disallowed in a custom scenario.
[*] Mods should now update to the latest version automatically once subscribed and downloaded.
[*] Fixed an issue where mods would inexplicably duplicate in the mod manager.
[*] Fixed an issue which allowed mods to be uploaded which used unsupported characters, thus causing subscribers to crash.
[*] Fixed an issue where mods missing certain files could cause the game to lock on a black screen.[/list]
One big change for the modding community is the ability for users to publish their mods as [b]Unlisted[/b] or [b]Private[/b]:
[list][*] [b]Unlisted:[/b] An Unlisted mod is not publicly available for users to find and download. It will, however, download automatically when a user joins a lobby where the mod is being run.
[*] [b]Private:[/b] A Private mod cannot be found, subscribed-to, or downloaded by any user other than the mod’s creator. This is a good way to test your mods before making them available to others.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]SCENARIO EDITOR[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where the [b]String ID[/b] field for trigger effects would default to [b]0[/b] rather than [b]-1[/b] if cleared.
[*] Adjusting the attack value of a lumberjack to [b]-15[/b] will now (properly) prevent them from damaging trees.
[*] Added the ability to disable the extra villager bonus granted to the Chinese and Mayan civilizations in the Options tab.[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 35209
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/fabb5a922baf9a0215e7e17d7e924665dc260bd1.png[/img]

Good day, everyone! This week's minor update comes with a handful of stability, bug, and crash fixes to improve your game experience, as well as a few quality of life updates to enhance some of the game's basic mechanics. There are [i]plenty[/i] more fixes in the works for another update later this month, so if you don't see a fix for an issue you're encountering, be sure to visit our [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]known issues page[/url] for insight into what's on the way. You can also visit one of our official channels to share your experience with the community:

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Hotfix 35209 Discussion[/url][/quote]
As always, there's more to come! For now: enjoy the update, and we'll see you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- HOTFIX 35209 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]GENERAL[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] [b]Boars[/b] once again require two shots to lure with military units: one to make it angry and a second to make it personal.
[*] [b]Villagers[/b] are still able to lure [b]boars[/b] with a single shot.
[*] If a player disconnects from a match before its conclusion, an autosave will now be automatically generated for that player.
[*] If the last player on one of the last two teams disconnects (or crashes) out of a match before its conclusion, the remaining players will now have the option to save and exit the map without revealing the battlefield or endgame statistics screen.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]FIXES[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]military kill and loss counts[/b] were only tallying trebuchet deaths and units lost to conversion.
[list][*] Kill requirements can now be completed during the [b]Atilla 1[/b], [b]Ivaylo 1[/b], and the [b]'Rushing the Enemy' (Art of War)[/b] mission.
[*] Animals killed by military units garrisoned structures will no longer provide food for collection (as intended).[/list]
[*] Fixed a crash caused by the over-enthusiastic use of taunts in the lobby or in-game chat.
[*] Fixed a crash caused when a lobby owner backed out of the match during the loading screen.
[*] Fixed an issue where the playback speed of recorded games could vary between two spectators.
[*] Fixed an issue where save game files would fail to display in the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where, upon re-loading a multiplayer match, the scoreboard would display the host as victorious.
[*] Fixed an uncommon issue where one player would be listed as all of the players in a multiplayer match.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where [b]boars[/b] would [i]always[/i] pursue the match owner when attacked by two players at the same time.
[*] Fixed a legacy issue where [b]Monk[/b] conversion times would vary based on the performance of the player's computer. This addresses an issue where conversions would sometimes complete faster than intended.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed a rare issue where [b]Mangonels[/b] would sometimes fail to deal their full damage.[/list]
[h3][b]Mayans[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an issue where the Mayans, in certain circumstances, could produce a [b]Villager[/b] at the start of the game despite being pop-capped.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where units on [b]patrol[/b] or [b]attack-move[/b] would fail to prioritize enemy units when attacking a structure.
[*] Improved the ability for [b]Fishing Ships[/b] to seek out new fish nodes after depleting their previous node.
[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] The ability to block the movement of enemy units is now more reliable and consistent across all unit types.
[*] Had a conversation about personal space with [b]villagers[/b] who would get uncomfortably close while gathering resources and constructing buildings.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where, in very specific circumstances, villagers could trap themselves while gathering resources.
[*] Fixed an infamous bug where melee units would stutter when pursuing other units.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]As always, we are continuing to track and work on fixes for issues as they are reported by the community. This month, our focus is on the stability of the game:
[list][*] [b]Regular disconnects within the first few minutes of a multiplayer match.[/b] We are currently working with players to collect information about this particular disconnect. You can join the discussion [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/1737758544545548821/]here[/url].
[/list]
For other known issues, please visit [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2/aoe2-issues/]this page[/url] to see some of the fixes coming in the future!
[quote][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] Please note that this list is subject to change and should not be considered a comprehensive list of the known issues we are tracking. Watch for our next full release for a  more comprehensive list of changes coming to the game![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 34793
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/0bacb8a010cd75894325cf194a893f1c499a6dae.png[/img]

Today's hotfix addresses three major issues that arose with Tuesday's Update, including a problem with walls, town centers, and AI unit movements! As always, please be sure to visit our official discussion channels to let us know if they're fixed or if you continue to experience issues playing the game.

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Hotfix 34793 Discussion[/url][/quote]
See you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- HOTFIX 34793 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]FIXES[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a bug that allowed units to ignore the singular purpose of walls.
[*] Fixed a bug where villagers could partially pass through buildings.
[*] Fixed a bug which resulted in certain units dealing massive damage to Town Centers.
[*] Fixed a bug which prevented the [b]Stop[/b] hotkey from working properly.
[*] Fixed a bug which motivated the AI to defend the westernmost corner of the map rather than participating in a match.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]ONGOING INVESTIGATION[/b] ◆[/h1]
We are continuing to track and work towards fixes for several issues reported by the community. Here are some of the priority reports which are currently in the process of being investigated:
[list][*] In some circumstances, units may path through buildings and gates. We are working on additional fixes to address the problem.
[*] Unit kills and deaths are not displayed correctly following a match.
[*] Animals killed by military units allow the animals to be gathered for food. This is not intended.
[/list]
If we are able to identify a solution, we may try and push a second hotfix within the next week. Stay tuned for more!

[quote][b]DISCLAIMER:[/b] Please note that this list is subject to change, and is *not* a comprehensive list of the known issues we are tracking. Watch for our next release for a full list of changes coming to the game![/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Update 34699
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35210618/456f344e2fef63a234c48d76b0263b5207da7325.png[/img]

Welcome, friends, to January 2020 and the first MAJOR update of the new year! Once again, the team has been working hard to put together a list of bug fixes, changes, and new features to continue moving [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] along the path to world domination. This month's update introduces a significant number of [b]stability[/b] and [b]performance improvements[/b], a planet's worth of [b]map and map-generation changes[/b], as well as [b]AI[/b] and [b]pathfinding[/b] improvements to help your armies as they traverse the world.

We're already working on February's major update, so be sure to drop by our discussion channels to share your feedback with the development team:

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/eventcomments/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - Update 34699 Discussion[/url][/quote]
Have an amazing new year; we’ll see you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]------------- UPDATE 34699 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]BUILD SPOTLIGHT[/b] ◆[/h1]
Here are some of the big highlights of today’s update. Most of these changes started as discussions within the community over the past month:
[list][*] [b]AI & Pathfinding Improvements[/b]
[*] [b]Numerous Game Stability Improvements & Crash Fixes![/b]
[*] [b]Balance Changes[/b]
[*] [b]Various Improvements to Random Maps[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]2020 Lunar New Year Event![/b][/h3][previewyoutube=B0zoMYrB4c8;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Now through February 4,[/b] come celebrate the [b]LUNAR NEW YEAR[/b] with [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition![/i] Starting today, you can unlock new profile icons and mods by completing a series of in-game tasks!
[list][*] [b]Sign into Xbox Live:[/b] New profile icon!
[*] [b]Play any Standard Game:[/b] Unlocks the ‘Mandarin Bushes’ mod, which changes all foraging bushes to mandarin bushes.
[/list]
Once you’ve completed the first two tasks, you can return and complete the following tasks each day to unlock additional rewards:
[list][*] [b]Win a Multiplayer Game:[/b] New profile icon!
[*] [b]Win 2 Multiplayer Games as Different Civilizations:[/b] Unlocks the ‘TC Decorations’ mod.
[list][*] Decorates all Town Centers with red lanterns and other festive ornamentation.[/list]
[*] [b]Reach 200 Population in any Multiplayer Game:[/b] New profile icon!
[*] [b]Win a Game against at least 1 Extreme AI:[/b] Unlocks the ‘Fireworks’ mod.
[list][*] Trebuchet projectiles impact in a fireworks display.
[*] Onager and Trebuchet shots that miss their targets land with a firecracker splash.
[*] Aging-up launches fireworks from your buildings to celebrate![/list][/list]
The challenges must be completed by [b]February 4th[/b]! After that point, the mods will disappear and your opportunity to unlock a new set of profile icons will slip away!
[/list]
Come celebrate!

[h3][b]Lunar New Year Event F.A.Q.[/b][/h3][b]Q:[/b] Do I have to complete the challenges on consecutive days?
[b]A:[/b] Nope! You can complete the challenges at your own pace, though the four additional tasks must be completed in consecutive order and on different days to unlock their benefits.

[b]Q:[/b] When is the last day I can complete the challenges?
[b]A:[/b] The Lunar New Year event concludes on [b]February 4th[/b].

[b]Q:[/b] What is Game Cosmetic 3104, 3105, and 3106?
[b]A:[/b] Oops! Those look like internal names that represent the three mods you can unlock:
[list][*] Game Cosmetic 3104 = 'Mandarin Bushes' mod
[*] Game Cosmetic 3105 = 'TC Decorations' mod
[*] Game Cosmetic 3106 = 'Fireworks' mod[/list]
Don't worry; as soon as you complete a challenge, the CORRECT name will be displayed.

[b]Q:[/b] Do I get to keep the mods?
[b]A:[/b] Not this time! The Lunar New Year mods are only available during the event and will automatically disable on [b]February 4th[/b].

[b]Q:[/b] Do I get to keep the profile icons?
[b]A:[/b] Yes! Profile icons are a permanent unlock on your account! As long as you complete the requirements before February 4th, you'll be able to find and select the new icons via your multiplayer profile.

[b]Q:[/b] What do I do if I accidentally unsubscribe from a special holiday mod?
[b]A:[/b] No problem! All you need to do is click the 'Lunar New Year' button on the main menu, select the challenge where you unlocked the mod, and click [b]Subscribe[/b] to re-add and re-download the mod.

[b]Q:[/b] How do I change my profile icon?
[b]A:[/b] You can update your profile icon by following these steps:
[olist][*] Click the Multiplayer shield.
[*] Select the Profile tab.
[*] Click the Change Icon button.
[*] Click to select the icon you want to use.
[*] You’re done![/olist]
[b]Q:[/b] How do I download and enable mods?
[b]A:[/b] For information about how to subscribe and prioritize your mods, visit [url=https://www.ageofempires.com/support/aoe2#modding]this article[/url].

[h1]◆ [b]GAME STABILITY[/b] ◆[/h1]
Game stability continues to be a focus as we work to fix the crashes and address performance issues reported by players. Here are the fixes coming with today’s update:
[list][*] Fixed an issue that would cause the game to crash on start-up.
[*] Fixed a crash that would affect players in [b]Spectator[/b] mode.
[*] Fixed a rare crash when skipping through the [b]Art of War[/b] videos.
[*] Implemented various other crash fixes.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented [b]save files[/b] containing non-Unicode text characters from transferring correctly when signing into another device.
[*] Implemented a warning message when a LAN server is blocked by a firewall.
[/list][quote]If you continue to experience issues following the build, please visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/]Steam[/url] or the [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/aoe2-de-bugs/102]official forum[/url] to provide details about the crash or disconnect, as well as any [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/1660069015238250725/]logs or errors[/url] you receive.[/quote]
[h1]◆ [b]PERFORMANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
We will continue to make adjustments to the game to ensure it runs smoothly on a variety of different machines. Today, we’re taking a shot at how the game uses RAM:
[list][*] Implemented improvements to RAM usage for configurations with dedicated VRAM. For configurations with less than 4GB of dedicated VRAM, we are continuing to work on performance improvements.[/list]
As always, there is a vast array of hardware and software combinations to accommodate as we continue to polish and perfect the game, so we want to hear if you’re still experiencing issues. Be sure to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/]visit the forum[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]come say hello on Discord[/url], where you can include as much technical information as possible so our team can begin to dig into the problem.

[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Livestock can now be garrisoned and transported in Transport Ships.
[*] Animals that can be ordered will no longer run faster than intended when tasked with waypoints.
[*] Increased the base speed of controllable animals.
[*] Double-clicking units no longer temporarily selects garrisoned units.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Villagers[/b] would sometimes not return to their work after being garrisoned inside a Castle.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where [b]Petards[/b] would fail to deal damage to Gates.
[*] [b]Fishing Ships[/b] will now put more effort into seeking out new fishing spots if their original gathering point is depleted.
[*] The [b]Guard[/b] hotkey for the [b]Bombard Cannon[/b] and [b]Mangonel[/b] now works as intended.
[*] Trade units will now prioritize the [b]Market[/b] that is furthest away for trading.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Monks[/b] would occasionally heal units beyond their intended range.
[*] The building preview now displays the correct graphic when the cursor is moved beyond the map’s edge.
[*] Multiple [b]Town Centers[/b] can now be queued up for construction by holding the [b]Shift[/b] key during placement mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]waypoints[/b] would sometimes display in incorrect positions.
[*] The [b]Anarchy[/b] technology now utilizes the correct hotkey.
[*] Removed the combat abilities from [b]Markets, Monasteries, Archery Ranges[/b], and [b]Stables[/b]. (These were previously only available by using gather points.)
[*] Cancelling the [b]Spies[/b] upgrade will now return the full cost rather than only returning 200 gold.
[*] Cancelling units in a production queue will now return the actual amount of resources initially spent on the unit. (This is a legacy issue from the CD version.)
[*] Players no longer receive additional score points for killing [b]Dismounted Konniks[/b].
[*] AI achievements can no longer be unlocked when playing campaign missions.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b] ◆[/h1]
Today's civilization changes are a bit smaller than last month's massive update. As always, your feedback continues to play a big part in how the balance is shifted among all the civilizations available in the game. Once you've had a chance to play with the changes, be sure to visit the forum(s) to post your thoughts!
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] The [b]Mayans[/b] and [b]Chinese[/b] will no longer be granted their bonus starting villagers until a [b]Town Center[/b] has been constructed.
[*] [b]Battle Elephant [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the training time from 28 to 24 seconds.[/list]
[h3][b]Burmese[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Arambai [Standard & Elite]:[/b] Reduced the wood cost from [b]80 wood, 65 gold[/b] to [b]75 wood, 60 gold[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]Chinese[/b][/h3][list][*] Can now research the [b]Block Printing[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]Khmer[/b][/h3][list][*] Farmers no longer require [b]Mills[/b] or [b]Town Centers[/b] to drop off food.[/list]
[h3][b]Persians[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the cost of [b]Archer[/b] units after researching the [b]Kamandaran[/b] technology from [b]50[/b] to [b]60[/b] wood.[/list]
[h3][b]Slavs[/b][/h3][list][*] Ranged Infantry units are no longer affected by the [b]Druzhina[/b] technology.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]CAMPAIGNS[/b] ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] Loading a saved campaign mission no longer causes certain objects to display the wrong names. (Note that this does not affect old saves.)
[*] Added the relevant dates and civilizations to each Campaign tooltip.[/list]
[h3][b]Art of War[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]‘Booming:’[/b] Fixed a rare issue where the Imperial Age upgrade could not be unlocked.[/list]
[h3][b]Campaign Missions[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Alaric 1: ‘The Battle of the Frigidus’:[/b] The two relics have been moved to more accessible locations.
[*] [b]Alaric 3: ‘The Belly of the Beast’:[/b] The two enemy cities will now attack more often on moderate and hard difficulties.
[*] [b]Alaric 4: ‘The Giant Falls’:[/b] The player now starts with extra pavilions.
[*] [b]Bari 5: ‘The Onrushing Tide’:[/b] A timer has been added to track how much time remains to protect the city during the final part of the mission.
[*] [b]Francisco de Almeida 3: ‘Ruins of Empires’:[/b] Fixed an exploit where a player could set their stance to neutral to safely convert hostile villagers without retaliation.
[*] [b]Francisco de Almeida 5: ‘A Son’s Blood’:[/b] Fixed an exploit where the player could win the scenario by constructing a wonder before receiving the objective to do so.
[*] [b]Francisco de Almeida 5: ‘A Son’s Blood’:[/b] Disabled the construction of [b]Transport Ships, Mangonels[/b], or the ability to upgrade to the [b]Imperial Age[/b] during the “Truce” part of the scenario.
[*] [b]Genghis Khan 4: ‘The Horde Rides West’:[/b] Fixed a cliff that could be improperly traversed after removing the surrounding trees.
[*] [b]Kotyan Khan 5: ‘A New Home’:[/b] The player can no longer research the [b]Redemption[/b] technology.
[*] [b]Le Loi 1: ‘The Dai Viet Uprising’:[/b] The secondary objective to bring the Relic Cart to the Monastery will now activate at the correct time.
[*] [b]Le Loi 1: ‘The Dai Viet Uprising’:[/b] Player 3 (AI) will no longer transfer all its assets to the player after completing the relic objective.
[*] [b]Le Loi 5: ‘A Three-Pronged Attack’:[/b] Fixed an issue where the AI would not participate in the mission as intended.
[*] [b]Le Loi 6: ‘The Final Fortress’:[/b] Fixed a minor AI issue that would make the scenario harder to complete than intended.
[*] [b]Pachacuti 3: ‘War of Brothers’:[/b] The player can now build siege units after defeating the vChanca.
[*] [b]Sundjata 1: ‘Hunted’:[/b] Fixed a crash that could be triggered under certain circumstances during the mission.
[*] [b]Sundjata 1: ‘Hunted’:[/b] The mission will now properly end when Sundjata is killed, as intended.
[*] [b]Sundjata 2: ‘The Sting of the Scorpion’:[/b] Fixed a crash that could be triggered under certain circumstances during the mission.
[*] [b]Sundjata 4: ‘Blood on the River Bank’:[/b] The objective to destroy the enemy will now update properly when completed.
[*] [b]Tariq ibn Ziyad 5: ‘Razzia’:[/b] Fixed an exploit where computer-controlled opponents would not activate if villagers were acquired early.
[*] [b]Yodit 1: ‘Path of Exile’:[/b] Increased the initial resources of the player. Gold and stone deposits are also more accessible to miners during the mission.
[*] [b]Yodit 1: ‘Path of Exile’:[/b] Enemy opponents now receive less [b]Shotel Warrior[/b] reinforcements.
[*] [b]Yodit 3: ‘A Fallen Crown’:[/b] The yellow team will now resign sooner when conditions are met.
[*] [b]Yodit 4: ‘Broken Stelae’:[/b] Secondary objectives will now update properly upon completion.
[*] [b]Yodit 4: ‘Broken Stelae’:[/b] Arab allies now send more ships, and allied tribes now receive additional units.
[*] [b]Yodit 4: ‘Broken Stelae’:[/b] If a stela is lost after completing the objective to control the stelae, the objective will now reactivate.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]RANDOM MAPS[/b] ◆[/h1]
While the civilizations tell the story of the game, the battlefields are the canvas upon which every story is written. Today’s update introduces a vast array of changes to the ways the maps are generated, how resources are placed and balanced for players, and even adds some scripting additions for our modding community to enjoy. The list is long, so give it a read before you make your mark on the next battlefield!
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Gold[/b] and [b]Stone[/b] deposits, as well as [b]Relics[/b], will more effectively avoid cliffs during map generation.
[*] [b]Relics[/b] will now avoid forests more effectively during map generation.
[*] Implemented additional logic to prevent [b]Scouts[/b] from spawning in forests.
[*] Starting [b]sheep[/b] will now spawn between [b]7-8[/b] tiles from the Town Center (was [b]8-9[/b] tiles).
[*] Team members’ walls that are adjacent to each other will now form a team wall instead of overlapping.
[*] Changed the way [b]Gates[/b] are generated on walled maps to reduce the chance of them being blocked.
[*] Restored the [b]Relic[/b] count to [b]5[/b] on the following tiny, small, and medium maps. Relics are also more fairly distributed in a 1v1 setting:
[list][*] Archipelago
[*] Black Forest
[*] Continental
[*] Fortress
[*] Highland
[*] Islands
[*] Team Islands[/list]
[*] Fixed a bug where trees in some forest types could be deleted by using building foundations. They must now be chopped down before building a structure.
[*] Dragon forests can now appear on more African-themed maps.
[*] Implemented various cosmetic updates to terrains used on all maps.[/list]
[h3][b]Map Settings[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]King of the Hill:[/b] The monument now generates resources for the controlling player.
[*] All [b]gold, stone, relics, straggler trees, boar, sheep[/b] and [b]fish[/b] have been removed from games set to [b]“Infinite”[/b] resources.[/list]
[h3][b]Map Generation & Layout[/b][/h3][list][*] The secondary [b]gold[/b] and [b]stone[/b] deposits are now more consistent and more closely resemble their original values on the following maps:
[list][*] Acropolis
[*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] Baltic
[*] Black Forest
[*] Budapest
[*] Cenotes
[*] City of Lakes
[*] Coastal
[*] Continental
[*] Fortress
[*] Ghost Lake
[*] Hideout
[*] Highland
[*] Hill Fort
[*] Lombardia
[*] Mediterranean
[*] Mongolia
[*] Nomad
[*] Oasis
[*] Rivers
[*] Salt Marsh
[*] Scandinavia
[*] Steppe
[*] Team Islands
[*] Valley
[*] Yucatan[/list]
[*] Acacia forests have been replaced by [b]palm/dragon forests[/b] on the following maps:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Coastal
[*] Continental
[*] Crater Lake
[*] Fortress
[*] Gold Rush
[*] Nomad
[*] Rivers
[*] Team Islands
[*] Valley[/list]
[*] Added a [b]Mediterranean[/b] season to the following maps:
[list][*] Arabia
[*] Arena
[*] Archipelago
[*] Black Forest
[*] Coastal
[*] Continental
[*] Crater Lake
[*] Gold Rush
[*] Golden Pit
[*] Hideout
[*] Highland

[*] Mediterranean

[*] Migration

[*] Enemy Islands
[*] Open Plains
[*] Swirling River
[*] The Eye
[*] Twin Forests
[*] YingYang
[*] Iberia
[*] Italy
[*] Byzantium[/list][/list]
[h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Added extra gold and stone nodes.
[*] [b]Acropolis:[/b] Adjusted the player starting positions so they all begin at an equal distance to the center of the map.
[*] [b]Archipelago:[/b] Fixed an issue where the starting gold nodes would fail to generate at the start of the map.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Straggler trees no longer appear within the walls.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Adjusted the forests so they at least partially appear within the walls.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Boars will now spawn in two different positions as opposed to one group.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Reduced the distance at which Boars spawn from the Town Center to [b]16-19[/b] tiles (was [b]30-35[/b] tiles).
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Walls will now consistently spawn 20 tiles from the Town Center. On ludicrous map size, they will spawn at 35 tiles from the Town Center.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Towers will now consistently spawn within 2 tiles of the wall.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Adjusted the generation of houses and other buildings so they do not impede the player.
[*] [b]Fortress:[/b] Improved the way farms are generated so they cleanly surround the Town Center.
[*] [b]Ghost Lake:[/b] Extra sheep spawns have been adjusted to form three groups of two sheep per player. These groups will only appear on the middle lake.
[*] [b]Golden Pit:[/b] Slightly increased the size of the pit in the center of the map.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Mangrove forests will now only appear on shallows.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Extra gold and stone deposits have been adjusted to spawn in more balanced locations for players.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Gold and stone deposits, as well as Relics, now spawn further away from forests.
[*] [b]Megarandom:[/b] Straggler trees will no longer be generated when playing a [b]Deathmatch[/b] or [b]Infinite Resources[/b].
[*] [b]Sandbank:[/b] Adjusted the location of gold and stone deposits.
[*] [b]Sandbank:[/b] Improved the placement of additional deer spawns.
[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] Adjusted the generation of forests and ice patches to offer easier navigation and access to the water.
[*] [b]Scandinavia:[/b] Resources have been moved closer to players’ initial starting positions.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Fixed a rare issue where gold and stone nodes would fail to generate at the start of the map.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Removed cliffs from the map.
[*] [b]Team Islands:[/b] Reduced the distance between islands from [b]22[/b] to [b]20[/b].
[*] [b]Yucatan:[/b] Teams are now interconnected by shallow terrain in case rivers block passage.
[*] [b]Yucatan:[/b] Adjusted how forests and terrain are generated to provide more open gameplay.
[*] [b]Wolf Hill:[/b] Extra gold and stone deposits now spawn further away from forests.[/list]
[h3][b]Random Map Scripting (RMS)[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]Sudden Death[/b] can now be used as an identifier for custom RMS scripts.
[*] Random maps can now place buildings on terrains without terrain restrictions.
[*] Random maps now generate the correct Gate types for all Wall types.
[*] [b]Capture the Relic:[/b] Custom Nomad scripts will now allow the player to build a Monastery if the map doesn’t start with one.
[*] Testing Random Map Scripts in the scenario editor now works correctly when teams are set using diplomacy settings.
[*] A new command [b]avoid_cliff_zone[/b] has been added to help prevent objects from appearing too close to cliffs. The distance can be set by using the same format as the [b]avoid_forest_zone[/b] command.
[*] Fixed an issue where setting [b]land_percent[/b] to 100 would occasionally fail to generate land on all available tiles. (For example, this would sometimes result in random patches of water on Highland.)
[*] The command, [b]set_scaling_to_player_number[/b], now works correctly when a map is generated in the scenario editor.
[*] The command, [b]circle_radius[/b], now supports a secondary value to define the variance of the circle. For example, [b]circle_radius 20 1[/b] would create a circle with radius 20 and variance 1.
[*] The command, [b]random_map.def[/b], now includes several new beach constants:
[list][*] ICYSHORE
[*] DLC_WETROCKBEACH
[*] DLC_GRAVELBEACH
[*] DLC_WETBEACH
[*] DLC_REEDSBEACH
[*] MEDITERRANEAN_FOREST
[*] CYPRESS_TREE
[*] ITALIAN_PINETREE
[*] OLIVE_TREE[/list][/list]

[h1]◆ [b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed an issue where [b]Custom Map[/b] pools would always reset to [b]Coastal[/b] after starting a new game session.
[*] Added a [b]password[/b] filter to the Lobby Browser.
[*] The [b]Regicide[/b] game mode will no longer remove the [b]‘Victory Condition’[/b] dropdown in multiplayer lobbies.
[*] The [b]‘Starting Resources’[/b] setting now works properly when playing [b]Regicide[/b].
[*] Fixed an issue where the check marks on the loading screen would, on occasion, not update properly.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]GRAPHICS[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a rare issue where unit outlines would fail to display behind construction graphics, Walls, and Gates.
[*] Added smoke visual effects to [b]Gate[/b] destruction animations.
[*] Implemented various bug fixes and updates to art assets.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]AUDIO[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed various issues where the voiceover dialog and subtitles did not match in campaign missions.
[*] Fixed the muzzle and sound delay of [b]Organ Guns, Bombard Cannons[/b], and [b]Hand Cannoneers[/b].
[*] Fixed the sound delay of [b]Hand Cannoneers[/b] and [b]Janissaries[/b].
[*] [b]Fire Arrows[/b] shot from Towers will now use the new tower-specific arrow sound, as intended.
[*] [b]Fire Arrows[/b] no longer play the [i]“whoosh”[/i] sound effect twice.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]AI[/b] ◆[/h1]
A good deal of work has been done to improve the AI and unit pathfinding in [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i]. Today’s update introduces several new balance changes: including fixes that should help the AI make more intelligent and meaningful decisions, pathfinding improvements for both AI- and player-controlled units, and more. We will continue monitoring your discussions to see what tweaks we can work into the game; but for now, here are the changes you can play with now:
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*] AI-controlled players will now continue to function in multiplayer games if the host has left the game.
[*] AI-controlled Scouts will now explore the map in custom scenarios.
[*] Added a localized response to [b]Taunt 31[/b] for AI players.
[*] [b]Extreme difficulty:[/b] AI-controlled [b]Eagle Scouts[/b] are now better at avoiding dangers while scouting.
[*] [b]Extreme difficulty:[/b] AI-controlled [b]Scouts[/b] will no longer try to continuously steal herdable animals.
[*] [b]Extreme difficulty:[/b] Fixed an issue where the AI would sometimes fail to counter enemy Rams with Villagers.
[*] Fixed an issue where the AI would prioritize building docks on the opposite side of the map despite starting near a body of water.
[*] AI-controlled players will now construct fewer docks if they are not planning to construct ships soon thereafter.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI players would flare where it was attacking too often.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI players would not flare where it was being attacked when asking for assistance.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI players would miscalculate their starting position when playing in a match with imbalanced teams.
[*] Fixed an issue where, in rare circumstances, starting with an [b]AI (CD)[/b] opponent on [b]Extreme[/b] difficulty would display an error message.
[*] Improved the behavior of villager migration to new islands.
[*] Implemented various improvements to the strategic decision-making capabilities of AI players.
[*] Implemented minor adjustments to difficulty scaling.[/list]
[h3][b]Pathfinding[/b][/h3][list][*] Improved the behavior of military units when they are surrounding and attacking buildings.
[*] Groups of units will now correctly make use of command queues.
[*] Fixed an issue where military units would, on occasion, visually stutter while moving.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Gates[/b] would, on occasion, briefly block units during their destruction animation.
[*] Fixed an issue where AI-controlled units in the campaign would stop attacking while in the [b]Attack Move[/b] stance.
[*] Fixed an issue where units could slide through obstructions if they were too close to fire while in the [b]Stand Ground[/b] stance.
[*] Fixed an issue where units on [b]Stand Ground[/b] would stutter after ungarrisoning from a Siege Tower.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Rams[/b] would randomly lose interest when attacking a Gate.
[*] Improved [b]Ram[/b] pathfinding when moving to and attacking Gates and Towers.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Villagers[/b] would sometimes ignore commands while under attack.
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]Villagers[/b] would occasionally go idle under certain circumstances. This also improves villager gathering behavior in crowded situations.
[*] The command, [b]sn-maximum-patrol-distance[/b], is now available for scenario designers to utilize the HD chasing behavior which broke the patrolling of individual units.[/list]
[h3][b]Scripting[/b][/h3]Several adjustments have been made to the AI’s scripting:[list][*] [b]up-cc-add-resource[/b] now also works for non-standard resources.
[*] [b]up-find-next-player[/b] now works correctly.
[*] [b]unit-type-count-total fact[/b] now counts units in queue.
[*] [b]up-object-type-count-total[/b] now counts units in queue.
[*] [b]up-get-point position-map-size[/b] is no longer off by 1.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]UI[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Updated the minimap to display the correct color for [b]gravel[/b] and [b]bogland[/b] terrain.
[*] The [b]Best Civ[/b] information on the player profile now shows the best civilization from both single player and multiplayer games.
[*] [b]Legacy HP[/b] colors are now displayed correctly in the UI.
[*] Placeholder text no longer displays when a player loses connectivity to multiplayer services.
[*] A [b]Villager’s[/b] build queue no longer resets when a villager within their group of selected units is killed.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where the unit command panel would not display properly.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented the correct display of allied units inside a building.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Spectator[/b] command panel would not display properly when selecting multiple units.
[*] Players who have resigned out of a match are now displayed correctly in the spectator UI.
[*] Fixed a bug where resigned co-op players would see their names replaced by their team name.
[*] Fixed an issue where hotkeys would continue to work in-game while the “Delete” confirmation window was in focus.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where multiple UI screens would overlap each other.
[*] Fixed a rare issue where AI names would not display properly on the loading screen.
[*] [b]Tech Tree:[/b] Unit stats are no longer inconsistent in the civilization tech tree when playing with a non-Dark Age start.
[*] [b]Tech Tree:[/b] Fixed a rare issue where researched unit or technology nodes did not appear correctly.
[*] [b]Tech Tree:[/b] Fixed a rare issue where some nodes did not include their required technologies.[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a bug where mods could not be downloaded on systems with non-English characters in the local username.
[*] By default, mods are now sorted by [b]“Popular.”[/b]
[*] Mod icons will no longer be reverted to the default icon when updating a mod.
[*] Added a [b]“Force Update Mod”[/b] button.
[*] Fixed an issue where it custom audio could not be used in the intro or outro slides of a custom campaign.
[*] Fixed an issue where attempting to override built-in campaign voiceover resulted in no audio at all.
[*] Unlisted mods now update properly.
[/list]

[h1]◆ [b]SCENARIO EDITOR[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Loading legacy scenarios in the Editor will now unlock all new content to be placeable in that scenario.
[*] Placeholder terrain is no longer visible under fog of war in some legacy scenarios.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented the ability to navigate text fields in the editor using the arrow keys.
[*] [b]Triggers:[/b] The object “visible” trigger condition now works correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition — Hotfix 34397
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210618/a6fd69cc80a69a42ec91c46748f248474101aa0d.png[/img]

Happy 2020, everyone! The first build of the year comes with a handful of fixes for issues that arose in the massive December Update ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/3996313225043504239]Update 34055[/url]) or which crept into the game with its first Hotfix ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/813780/announcements/detail/1692722548283751484]34223[/url]). It includes the return of major [b]performance fixes[/b] introduced (initially) with last month’s build, a fix for the “[b]Castle Age Crash[/b]” which kicks players out of the game as they’re Aging-up, as well as [b]new fixes[/b] for issues that have been prevalent subjects of discussion amongst the community.

And as always: once you’ve had the opportunity to play with the new build, we WELCOME your feedback!

[h3]A Note on Game Issues[/h3]
Crashes, disconnects, and bugs are frustrating—both as players and as developers of the game. It’s impossible to anticipate every problem, which is why we will continue working with you to gather information, gain an understanding the issue, and hopefully find a solution that gets you online and playing. Sadly, these issues don’t always come with a simple fix, which is why we ask that you [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/1660069015238250725/]gather and include as much information as possible whenever you report a problem[/url]!

[quote]Here’s where you can search for discussions or start a new discussion (if one doesn’t already exist) about problems you encounter in the game:
[list][*] Experiencing a technical issue? Search or post on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/3/]Steam[/url] or the [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/aoe2-de-bugs/102]official forum[/url]!
[*]Encountered a game bug? Search or post on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/813780/discussions/2/]Steam[/url] or [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-ii/aoe2-de-bugs/102]official forum[/url]![/list][/quote]
Finding a fix can also take time, and we appreciate your patience as we work to investigate, test, and implement new improvements during the early months of the game! We’re already working on a new, major content update aimed for later this month, and will continue to monitor your discussions as you have time to play with today’s build!

Plenty more to come, but for now: [b]Enjoy the update[/b]!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team


[h1][b]------------- HOTFIX 34397 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]FIXES[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a crash that could trigger when upgrading to a new Age—most notably to the Castle or Imperial Age.
[*] Fixed a crash triggered when loading into a match as a spectator.
[*] Fixed an issue that was impacting some of the prior performance gains initially released with the December Update.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed units with minimum range attacks to pass through obstructions.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented certain battle audio from playing on machines with Vsync enabled.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that prevented control group numbers from displaying next to grouped units.
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused the banned map cross to disappear after queuing for a ranked match.
[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]MODDING[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Fixed a bug that prevented music mods from working in-game.
[/list]

[quote][b]NOTE:[/b] Some users have mentioned that their game no longer launches after the update. If you were able to play previously, make sure you add your [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i] client as an exception to your firewall and antivirus programs.[/quote]
